title: AI Values Atlas
tagline: Research on how values are represented, measured, expressed, chosen, and steered in AI systems.

domains.name: Value theory and axiologies
domains.question: Which values exist, and how are they structured?

domains.name: Measurement and profiling
domains.question: How are AI values elicited and summarized?

domains.name: Reliability, validity, and auditing
domains.question: When is a reported value result stable and valid?

domains.name: Moral and value understanding
domains.question: Can systems identify, explain, or reason about values and norms?

domains.name: Choice, action, and behavior
domains.question: Which values govern choices and behavior under conflict?

domains.name: Culture, opinions, and social representation
domains.question: Whose cultures, opinions, and social perspectives are represented?

domains.name: Pluralism and preference aggregation
domains.question: How should heterogeneous values and preferences be represented or aggregated?

domains.name: Alignment and steering
domains.question: How are normative targets used to train or steer systems?

domains.name: Value representations and model internals
domains.question: How is value information represented, learned, or causally encoded?

domains.name: Field reviews, reporting, and governance
domains.question: How is the field organized, documented, and governed?

works.title: Strategy-Proofness and Arrow's Conditions: Existence and Correspondence Theorems for Voting Procedures and Social Welfare Functions
works.description: Establishes foundational existence and correspondence results linking strategy-proof voting procedures to Arrow-style social-welfare conditions, informing preference aggregation limits.

works.title: The theory of planned behavior
works.description: Provides the foundational intention–attitude–norm–control model of human behavior, useful context for distinguishing stated values from action but not an AI-value method.

works.title: Universals in the Content and Structure of Values: Theoretical Advances and Empirical Tests in 20 Countries
works.description: Defines and empirically tests the ten motivational value types and their relational structure across 20 countries, providing the foundational Schwartz value space.

works.title: Extending the Cross-Cultural Validity of the Theory of Basic Human Values with a Different Method of Measurement
works.description: Introduces the less abstract Portrait Values Questionnaire and validates the ten-value relational structure in large South African, Italian, and Ugandan samples.

limitations: Participant-level study data and analysis software are not supplied as a modern reusable bundle

works.title: Moral Foundations Theory: The Pragmatic Validity of Moral Pluralism
works.description: Consolidates Moral Foundations Theory, its pluralist assumptions and empirical record, incorporates critiques, and specifies five criteria for recognizing a moral foundation.

works.title: Data Statements for Natural Language Processing: Toward Mitigating System Bias and Enabling Better Science
works.description: Important for cultural and linguistic reporting of value datasets, but not a value construct or evaluation method.
limitations: Data statements expose limitations but do not themselves repair sampling or representation harms.
The proposal is general to NLP rather than AI values.

works.title: Fairness and Abstraction in Sociotechnical Systems
works.description: Identifies five abstraction traps that make technical fairness interventions fail in social context and reframes design around sociotechnical processes and actors.

works.title: Model Cards for Model Reporting
works.description: Direct conceptual ancestor of value model cards, but not evidence about AI values or value measurement.
limitations: Documentation can report rather than prevent misuse or overclaim.
The general template does not resolve value-specific construct and scorer choices.

works.title: Social Bias Frames: Reasoning about Social and Power Implications of Language
works.description: Defines a structured pragmatic representation of social bias and power and contributes 150k annotations covering more than 34k implications about roughly 1,000 groups.

works.title: Aligning AI With Shared Human Values
works.description: Directly addresses moral-judgment knowledge and alignment, but not a model's multidimensional personal-value profile.
limitations: Predicting widespread judgments may suppress moral disagreement and minority perspectives.
Moral classification accuracy does not establish aligned behavior in open-ended contexts.

works.title: Closing the AI Accountability Gap: Defining an End-to-End Framework for Internal Algorithmic Auditing
works.description: Organizational values motivate audits, but model-value measurement and representation are not the research target.
limitations: Internal audits depend on organizational authority, incentives, and audit independence.
The abstract does not provide outcome validation of the framework's effects.

works.title: CrowS-Pairs: A Challenge Dataset for Measuring Social Biases in Masked Language Models
works.description: Introduces 1,508 minimally contrasting stereotype pairs across nine protected dimensions and demonstrates systematic stereotyped preferences in three masked LMs.

works.title: Learning Norms from Stories: A Prior for Value Aligned Agents
works.description: Learns a normative prior from naturally occurring didactic stories and tests transfer of normative versus non-normative situation classification.

works.title: Learning to summarize from human feedback
works.description: Establishes a scalable human-comparison, reward-model, and reinforcement-learning pipeline that optimizes perceived summary quality beyond reference and ROUGE proxies.

works.title: Moral Foundations Twitter Corpus: A Collection of 35k Tweets Annotated for Moral Sentiment
works.description: Releases 35,108 tweets from seven domains, each annotated by at least three trained raters across ten Moral Foundations sentiment categories with annotator metadata.

works.title: Moral Stories: Situated Reasoning about Norms, Intents, Actions, and their Consequences
works.description: Useful for studying value-informed action and consequences, though centered on social norms rather than explicit value profiles.
limitations: Crowd norms and narrative templates may encode annotator and cultural assumptions.
Generated moral actions are not equivalent to stable model values.

works.title: RealToxicityPrompts: Evaluating Neural Toxic Degeneration in Language Models
works.description: Creates a 100k-prompt toxicity test bed, compares controllable-generation interventions, and traces persistent toxic degeneration to pretraining corpora.

works.title: Scruples: A Corpus of Community Ethical Judgments on 32,000 Real-Life Anecdotes
works.venue: 000 real-life anecdotes. Lourie et al. AAAI.
works.description: Contributes 625,000 distributed ethical judgments over 32,000 real-life anecdotes and methods that separate irreducible disagreement from model uncertainty.

works.title: Social Chemistry 101: Learning to Reason about Social and Moral Norms
works.description: Major source for contextual moral/value artifacts, but primarily represents human social norms rather than LLM value identity.
limitations: Everyday rules of thumb may reflect dominant-platform culture and descriptive bias.
Generated norms can reproduce annotation and source-community assumptions.

works.title: Would you Rather? A New Benchmark for Learning Machine Alignment with Cultural Values and Social Preferences
works.description: Frames alignment as predicting crowd-voted preferences between culturally and socially situated scenarios and benchmarks multiple neural models.

works.title: A Framework for Understanding Sources of Harm throughout the Machine Learning Life Cycle
works.description: Provides a seven-source lifecycle framework for locating downstream machine-learning harms from data collection through development and deployment.

works.title: A General Language Assistant as a Laboratory for Alignment
works.description: Establishes helpful, honest, and harmless assistant evaluations and scaling comparisons among prompting, imitation, discrimination, and ranked preference modeling.

limitations: Training data, complete experimental code, and checkpoints are unavailable
The supplementary gist is not a full data release
Proprietary models and internal training stack prevent reconstruction

works.title: Analysis of Moral Judgement on Reddit
works.description: Trains an AITA-derived moral-valence classifier and applies it to behavioral patterns across ten other subreddits.

works.title: Can Machines Learn Morality? The Delphi Experiment
works.description: Directly models moral judgments, though it predicts population norms rather than a multidimensional model-value profile.
limitations: Descriptive majority judgments are not equivalent to moral truth or plural human values.
The abstract acknowledges pervasive biases and inconsistencies.

works.title: Datasheets for Datasets
works.description: Essential release practice for value datasets, but not a study or representation of AI values itself.
limitations: Documentation quality and adoption do not guarantee dataset validity or responsible downstream use.
The framework is intentionally general rather than value-specific.

works.title: Ethical and social risks of harm from Language Models
works.description: Synthesizes 21 language-model risks across six multidisciplinary areas, traces their origins, and links them to mitigation and organizational responsibility.

works.title: Measurement and Fairness
works.description: Supplies core measurement reasoning for AI-value profiling, but does not itself define or evaluate model values.
limitations: Conceptual applicability to LLM value constructs requires domain-specific operationalization.
No value-specific empirical validation is claimed.

works.title: On the Dangers of Stochastic Parrots: Can Language Models Be Too Big?
works.description: Provides a field-shaping critique of scale, data documentation, environmental and social costs, hegemonic bias, and mistaken attribution of meaning to language-model output.

works.title: Process for Adapting Language Models to Society (PALMS) with Values-Targeted Datasets
works.description: Introduces an iterative process for defining target values, curating correction data, fine-tuning models, and reevaluating value adherence without sacrificing general capability.

limitations: Values-targeted training corpus is not released as a reusable dataset
Model checkpoints and training code are proprietary
Appendix examples and hyperparameters do not form an executable release

works.title: ValueNet: A New Dataset for Human Value Driven Dialogue System
works.description: A core dataset/model artifact connecting human-value detection to generated dialogue behavior.
limitations: The abstract does not describe annotator populations, agreement, or cultural coverage.
Downstream task gains do not by themselves validate the inferred value distributions.

works.title: Visually Grounded Reasoning across Languages and Cultures
works.description: Creates MaRVL through native-speaker-driven concepts and images across five languages and demonstrates severe cross-cultural transfer gaps in vision-language models.

works.title: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback
works.description: Combines browser-based imitation learning, cited evidence, preference modeling, and rejection sampling to optimize long-form answers for human judgments.

works.title: BBQ: A hand-built bias benchmark for question answering
works.description: Provides a controlled, hand-built QA benchmark across nine protected dimensions that separates stereotype reliance under ambiguous and informative contexts.

works.title: Challenges and Strategies in Cross-Cultural NLP
works.description: Distinguishes cross-cultural from merely multilingual NLP and supplies a principled framework and strategy taxonomy for culturally responsive systems.

works.title: CommunityLM: Probing Partisan Worldviews from Language Models
works.description: Fine-tunes community-specific models on partisan discourse and validates their elicited worldviews against ANES survey responses.

works.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
works.description: Foundational for value-principle alignment, though its primary objective is harmlessness rather than descriptive value measurement.
limitations: Outcomes depend on the chosen constitution and AI evaluator.
Harmlessness performance does not by itself establish pluralistic or comprehensive human-value alignment.

works.title: Despite "super-human" performance, current LLMs are unsuited for decisions about ethics and safety
works.description: Shows that super-human aggregate ETHICS accuracy masks systematic, adversarially exploitable errors and disturbing generated justifications.

works.title: Does Moral Code Have a Moral Code? Probing Delphi's Moral Philosophy
works.description: Uses standardized morality questionnaires to recover higher-level ethical tendencies in Delphi and ties them to its annotator demographics.

works.title: EnCBP: A New Benchmark Dataset for Finer-Grained Cultural Background Prediction in English
works.description: Contributes an English cultural-background prediction dataset and demonstrates culturally conditioned linguistic variation, but does not directly model AI values.

works.title: Evaluating and Inducing Personality in Pre-trained Language Models
works.description: Introduces a Big Five-based Machine Personality Inventory and a controllable personality-prompting method, offering an important neighboring psychometric paradigm.

works.title: Fine-tuning language models to find agreement among humans with diverse preferences
works.description: Learns individual preferences and explicitly varies social-welfare aggregation to generate consensus statements preferred over prompted and human-written alternatives.

limitations: No dedicated official code or data repository was identified
The 70B model family and training stack are unavailable
Full preference-elicitation and fine-tuning data are not released

works.title: Improving alignment of dialogue agents via targeted human judgements
works.description: Introduces rule-specific human judgments and evidence-supported preference collection for Sparrow, with adversarial and distributional-bias evaluation.

limitations: Dialogue model, preference model, training code, and complete training data are unavailable
Only rules, sample transcripts, ratings, and extensive methodological detail are published

works.title: Inertia in Moral and Value Judgments of Large Language Models
works.description: Uses large-scale randomized persona role-play to identify persistent value orientation and inertia, especially for harm avoidance and fairness.

works.title: Large Pre-trained Language Models Contain Human-like Biases of What is Right and Wrong to Do
works.description: Operationalizes a geometric moral direction in embedding space and demonstrates zero-shot normativity scoring and toxicity-oriented generation steering.

works.title: Probing Pre-Trained Language Models for Cross-Cultural Differences in Values
works.description: Introduces cross-cultural value probes and directly tests model representations against established theories and survey measurements, finding only weak alignment.

works.title: ProsocialDialog: A Prosocial Backbone for Conversational Agents
works.description: Releases 58k dialogues, 160k rules of thumb, and 497k safety labels and uses them to build norm-generating and prosocial-response models.

works.title: Re-contextualizing Fairness in NLP: The Case of India
works.description: Builds India-specific fairness resources, documents regional and religious stereotypes, and proposes a generalizable geo-cultural research agenda.

works.title: Red Teaming Language Models to Reduce Harms: Methods, Scaling Behaviors, and Lessons Learned
works.description: Systematizes model red teaming across scale and training regimes and releases 38,961 attacks with methodological and uncertainty documentation.

works.title: SafeText: A Benchmark for Exploring Physical Safety in Language Models
works.description: Introduces paired safe and unsafe advice scenarios to measure commonsense physical-safety failures in generation and reasoning models.

works.title: Social Simulacra: Creating Populated Prototypes for Social Computing Systems
works.description: Develops LLM-generated populated social prototypes and shows designers can use simulated interactions and interventions to refine system designs.

works.title: The Moral Foundations Reddit Corpus
works.description: Provides 16,123 multi-annotated Reddit comments across eight updated Moral Foundations categories and benchmarks encoder and LLM classification approaches.

works.title: The Moral Integrity Corpus: A Benchmark for Ethical Dialogue Systems
works.description: Captures 99k explanatory moral rules for 38k dialogue pairs, organizes them with nine attributes, and benchmarks explicit modeling of chatbot moral assumptions.

works.title: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
works.description: Establishes an iterative preference-modeling and RLHF pipeline for helpfulness and harmlessness and analyzes robustness, objective competition, and reward–KL scaling.

limitations: Training and evaluation code are not released
The 52B base, preference, and policy checkpoints are not released
The GitHub repository is archived and points to Hugging Face
Exact training and evaluation cannot be reconstructed from data alone

works.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
works.description: Introduces the InstructGPT demonstration, ranking, reward-model, and RLHF pipeline and shows strong human preference gains from aligning GPT-3 to user intent.

works.title: When to Make Exceptions: Exploring Language Models as Accounts of Human Moral Judgment
works.description: Introduces MoralExceptQA and theory-grounded MORALCOT prompting to predict when humans permit rule breaking, outperforming seven LLM baselines.

works.title: Who is GPT-3? An Exploration of Personality, Values and Demographics
works.description: Directly profiles model-stated values and helped establish questionnaire-based LLM psychometrics.
limitations: The study concerns one now-old model and depends on a response-memory setup.
Self-reported demographics and anthropomorphic identity language have weak construct grounding.
README contains only the title
Only selected CSV outputs are present
No analysis or figure-rebuild scripts
No dependency specification
Historical proprietary GPT-3 endpoint cannot be frozen

works.title: AI Alignment and Social Choice: Fundamental Limitations and Policy Implications
works.description: Applies social-choice impossibility results to show there is no unique universally democratic RLHF rule and derives transparency and scoped-alignment policy implications.

works.title: AI Alignment: A Comprehensive Survey
works.description: Organizes alignment around robustness, interpretability, controllability, and ethicality and separates forward training from backward assurance and governance.

works.title: AI-Augmented Surveys: Leveraging Large Language Models and Surveys for Opinion Prediction
works.description: Combines question, respondent, and period representations to retrodict missing General Social Survey trends and predict unasked opinions while auditing homogenization.

works.title: Align on the Fly: Adapting Chatbot Behavior to Established Norms
works.description: Stores updateable legal and moral rules in external memory and performs streaming on-the-fly preference optimization without modifying model parameters.

works.title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Opinions through Persona Selection and Value--Belief--Norm Reasoning
works.description: Filters persona attributes and reasons through explicit values, beliefs, and norms to improve opinion prediction and fine-tuned opinion alignment.

works.title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human: A Survey
works.description: Systematizes alignment data collection, supervised and preference training, parameter-efficient methods, and multifaceted evaluation with a maintained bibliography.

works.title: An Evaluation of GPT-4 on the ETHICS Dataset
works.description: Provides a focused five-subset ETHICS evaluation of GPT-4 and argues that high-consensus moral classification is substantially easier than unresolved ethical alignment.

works.title: Assessing Cross-Cultural Alignment between ChatGPT and Human Societies: An Empirical Study
works.description: Compares cultural-difference questionnaire responses and shows that English prompting flattens variation toward an American profile while non-U.S. adaptation remains weak.

works.title: Assessing LLMs for Moral Value Pluralism
works.description: Uses a value-resonance model to map open-ended generations into World Values Survey dimensions and compare implicit moral profiles with demographic and cultural references.

works.title: BeaverTails: Towards Improved Safety Alignment of LLM via a Human-Preference Dataset
works.description: Releases 333,963 safety-labeled QA pairs and 361,903 expert helpfulness and harmlessness comparisons with moderation and RLHF demonstrations.

works.title: CDEval: A Benchmark for Measuring the Cultural Dimensions of Large Language Models
works.description: Builds a human-verified benchmark covering six cultural dimensions across seven domains and evaluates cross-model consistency and variation.

works.title: Cultural Alignment in Large Language Models: An Explanatory Analysis Based on Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions
works.description: Introduces a latent-variable Hofstede Cultural Alignment Test and varies prompts and language-specific fine-tuning across U.S., Chinese, and Arab reference profiles.

works.title: Cultural Bias and Cultural Alignment of Large Language Models
works.description: Directly studies cultural-value alignment, although it is confined to one vendor's model series.
limitations: The model panel contains only OpenAI endpoints from related generations.
Survey similarity and cultural prompting do not establish authentic cultural competence.

works.title: Cultural Concept Adaptation on Multimodal Reasoning
works.description: Introduces annotation-free cultural concept mapping and CultureMixup augmentation across text and images, improving low-resource multimodal reasoning in five languages.

works.title: Culturally Aware Natural Language Inference
works.description: Creates 2,700 NLI pairs annotated by U.S. and Indian groups and treats culturally grounded label disagreement as the evaluation signal for norm-sensitive understanding.

works.title: CValues: Measuring the Values of Chinese Large Language Models from Safety to Responsibility
works.description: Builds the first Chinese benchmark separating adversarial safety across ten scenarios from expert-designed responsibility across eight domains, with human and automatic evaluation.

works.title: Demonstrations of the Potential of AI-based Political Issue Polling
works.description: Simulates thousands of demographic-conditioned issue responses and compares means and distributions with Cooperative Election Study polls, including temporal and subgroup failures.

works.title: DLAMA: A Framework for Curating Culturally Diverse Facts for Probing the Knowledge of Pretrained Language Models
works.description: Builds 78,259 balanced factual triples across three cultural contrasts and demonstrates Western knowledge skew, but evaluates factual recall rather than values.

works.title: Do Differences in Values Influence Disagreements in Online Discussions?
works.description: Extracts and aggregates value profiles from discussion text and tests whether value distance explains human-annotated disagreement and improves its prediction.

works.title: EALM: Introducing Multidimensional Ethical Alignment in Conversational Information Retrieval
works.description: Integrates ethical screening into conversational retrieval and releases QA-ETHICS plus MP-ETHICS for binary and multidimensional judgments including justice and deontology.

works.title: Enhancing Stance Classification on Social Media Using Quantified Moral Foundations
works.description: Adds text-derived Moral Foundations features to message- and user-level stance prediction and links moral concerns to observed online positions.

works.title: EtiCor: Corpus for Analyzing LLMs for Etiquettes
works.description: Creates region-specific etiquette text from five world regions, defines etiquette sensitivity, and reveals major non-Western norm-understanding gaps.

works.title: Evaluating the Moral Beliefs Encoded in LLMs
works.description: Develops probabilistic choice, uncertainty, and consistency measures and administers 1,367 high- and low-ambiguity moral scenarios to 28 models.

works.title: Exploring the psychology of LLMs' Moral and Legal Reasoning
works.description: Replicates eight human moral and legal psychology experiments across four model families and identifies systematic variance compression and study-dependent human correspondence.

works.title: FORK: A Bite-Sized Test Set for Probing Culinary Cultural Biases in Commonsense Reasoning Models
works.description: Offers a small manually curated probe of U.S. versus non-U.S. culinary assumptions in commonsense systems, measuring cultural knowledge rather than values.

works.title: Foundational Moral Values for AI Alignment
works.description: Proposes five philosophically motivated alignment values—survival, sustainable intergenerational existence, society, education, and truth—as a more explicit target structure.

works.title: From Instructions to Intrinsic Human Values -- A Survey of Alignment Goals for Big Models
works.description: Surveys definitions and evaluations across three levels of alignment goals and traces a shift from capability and instruction following toward intrinsic value targets.

works.title: From Pretraining Data to Language Models to Downstream Tasks: Tracking the Trails of Political Biases Leading to Unfair NLP Models
works.description: Traces social and economic political bias from pretraining corpora through model representations into unfair hate-speech and misinformation decisions.

works.title: From Values to Opinions: Predicting Human Behaviors and Stances Using Value-Injected Large Language Models
works.description: Introduces two value-injection methods and tests whether targeted value distributions improve prediction of opinions and behavior across four tasks.

works.title: GIVL: Improving Geographical Inclusivity of Vision-Language Models with Pre-Training Methods
works.description: Adds pretraining objectives for balanced geo-diverse visual concepts and improves regional capability, with no direct value construct.

works.title: Global Voices, Local Biases: Socio-Cultural Prejudices across Languages
works.description: Extends association-bias measurement to 24 languages with locally relevant dimensions and a detailed six-language Indian analysis.

works.title: HelpSteer: Multi-attribute Helpfulness Dataset for SteerLM
works.description: Releases 37,000 responses labeled for correctness, coherence, complexity, verbosity, and helpfulness and demonstrates controllable SteerLM training.

works.title: Heterogeneous Value Alignment Evaluation for Large Language Models
works.description: Uses Social Value Orientation to induce heterogeneous welfare priorities and introduces value rationality for testing whether five models behaviorally preserve assigned values.

works.title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
works.description: Provides evaluation infrastructure and harm metrics but does not specifically represent or measure human values.
limitations: Holistic coverage remains an explicitly incomplete selection of scenarios and metrics.
Its broad aggregate scope can obscure construct-specific value measurement questions.

works.title: How Accurate are GPT-3’s Hypotheses About Social Science Phenomena?
works.description: Preregisters model predictions and validates them against two 600-person studies, showing task-specific prompting and tuning can predict ideological attitude correlations but do not automate theory.

works.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
works.description: Introduces MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena, documents judge position, verbosity, self-enhancement, and reasoning biases, and validates model judges against expert and crowd preferences.

works.title: Knowledge of cultural moral norms in large language models
works.description: Uses World Values Survey and Pew morality data across up to 55 countries to test both fine-grained norm prediction and global patterns of agreement and divergence.

works.title: Large Language Model Alignment: A Survey
works.description: Surveys outer and inner LLM alignment, interpretability, adversarial vulnerabilities, benchmarks, and evaluation while connecting capability and safety communities.

works.title: Large Language Models as Superpositions of Cultural Perspectives
works.description: Reframes models as context-dependent superpositions rather than fixed personalities and quantifies perspective controllability with PVQ, VSM, and IPIP across five models.

works.title: Large Language Models Can Be Used to Estimate the Latent Positions of Politicians
works.description: Derives politician positions from pairwise model comparisons and Bradley-Terry scaling and validates novel gun-control and abortion measures against votes and interest-group ratings.

works.title: Large Language Models Empowered Agent-based Modeling and Simulation: A Survey and Perspectives
works.description: Surveys LLM agent-based simulation across cyber, physical, social, and hybrid settings and covers alignment only as one architectural challenge.

works.title: Machine Mindset: An MBTI Exploration of Large Language Models
works.description: Creates personality data and combines fine-tuning with DPO to induce stable MBTI-labeled response styles across domains.

works.title: Moral Mimicry: Large Language Models Produce Moral Rationalizations Tailored to Political Identity
works.description: Shows GPT and OPT models reproduce Moral Foundations language associated with liberal and conservative identities and analyzes mimicry by scale.

works.title: MoralDial: A Framework to Train and Evaluate Moral Dialogue Systems via Moral Discussions
works.description: Decomposes moral communication into expressing, explaining, revising, and inferring views and supplies discussion-based training plus multifaceted human-value evaluation.

works.title: More human than human: measuring ChatGPT political bias
works.description: Uses impersonation contrasts, randomized repeated questioning, bootstrap inference, dose-response, placebo, and cross-country robustness tests to estimate ChatGPT political skew.

works.title: Multi-lingual and Multi-cultural Figurative Language Understanding
works.description: Creates culturally grounded figurative-language inference data for seven underrepresented languages and measures capability gaps rather than values.

works.title: Multilingual Language Models are not Multicultural: A Case Study in Emotion
works.description: Shows multilingual embeddings and generations remain Anglocentric in culturally varying emotional expression, separating multilingual capability from multicultural sensitivity.

works.title: NLPositionality: Characterizing Design Biases of Datasets and Models
works.description: Continuously collects 16,299 judgments from 1,096 people in 87 countries and quantifies whose social-acceptability and hate-speech positions datasets and models represent.

works.title: NormBank: A Knowledge Bank of Situational Social Norms
works.description: Provides 155,000 norms grounded in 63,000 role, setting, attribute, physical, social, and cultural constraints and demonstrates non-monotonic contextual reasoning and transfer.

works.title: NormSAGE: Multi-Lingual Multi-Cultural Norm Discovery from Conversations On-the-Fly
works.description: Discovers conversation-grounded norms across languages with self-verification, human quality comparisons, culture identification, and high-AUC adherence grounding.

works.title: On the steerability of large language models toward data-driven personas
works.description: Defines latent personas through collaborative filtering of observed opinions rather than demographics and reports large improvements in viewpoint steering.

works.title: Personalisation within bounds: A risk taxonomy and policy framework for the alignment of large language models with personalised feedback
works.description: Diagnoses aggregate-alignment exclusion, develops an individual and societal personalization risk-benefit taxonomy, and proposes a three-tier governance framework for bounded personalization.

works.title: Personalized Soups: Personalized Large Language Model Alignment via Post-hoc Parameter Merging
works.description: Formulates personalized feedback as multi-objective alignment and shows that independently trained preference dimensions can be composed post hoc through parameter merging.

works.title: Position: AI Evaluation Should Learn from How We Test Humans
works.description: Relevant methodological background for adaptive value testing, not a value-specific contribution.
limitations: No empirical validation is claimed in the abstract.
Human psychometric assumptions may not transfer directly to foundation models.

works.title: Potential benefits of employing large language models in research in moral education and development
works.description: Connects LLM capabilities to moral-development research through a review and preliminary experiments on ethical dilemmas, feedback revision, and moral exemplars.

works.title: Principle-Driven Self-Alignment of Language Models from Scratch with Minimal Human Supervision
works.description: Introduces SELF-ALIGN, using a small human-written principle set and model-generated demonstrations to create Dromedary with minimal direct supervision.

works.title: Probing the Moral Development of Large Language Models through Defining Issues Test
works.description: Adapts the established Defining Issues Test to compare LLM moral-development profiles with human reference populations and exposes dilemma-level inconsistency.

works.title: Rethinking Machine Ethics -- Can LLMs Perform Moral Reasoning through the Lens of Moral Theories?
works.description: Builds a theory-guided framework for steering and evaluating LLM moral reasoning and relates explicit moral theories to existing morality datasets.

works.title: Safety and Ethical Concerns of Large Language Models
works.description: Provides a broad tutorial overview of LLM bias, robustness, poisoning, and harmful-generation concerns without a distinct value construct or reported research artifact.

works.title: Safety Assessment of Chinese Large Language Models
works.description: Contributes a Chinese safety benchmark, a 100k prompt-response release, and comparisons of 15 models across safety scenarios and instruction attacks.

works.title: SafetyBench: Evaluating the Safety of Large Language Models
works.description: Provides an 11,435-item bilingual benchmark covering seven safety categories and reports broad evaluation across 25 models.

works.title: SeeGULL: A Stereotype Benchmark with Broad Geo-Cultural Coverage Leveraging Generative Models
works.description: Creates a globally broad stereotype resource spanning 178 countries, validates it with diverse raters, and measures within-region versus North American perceptions.

works.title: SemEval-2023 Task 4: ValueEval: Identification of Human Values Behind Arguments
works.description: Important scorer dataset for value-bearing text, though the target texts are human arguments rather than LLM profiles.
limitations: Several values remain difficult to identify, with reported peak F1 around 0.39.
Transfer from arguments to generated assistant responses is not established.

works.title: SocialDial: A Benchmark for Socially-Aware Dialogue Systems
works.description: Introduces a Chinese social-norm dialogue corpus with 1,563 human dialogues, 4,870 synthetic conversations, and fine-grained relation, context, distance, and norm labels.

works.title: SteerLM: Attribute Conditioned SFT as an (User-Steerable) Alternative to RLHF
works.description: Replaces a single implicit reward with inference-time control over explicit multidimensional response attributes and demonstrates competitive preference performance.

works.title: The Capacity for Moral Self-Correction in Large Language Models
works.description: Establishes scale- and RLHF-dependent moral self-correction across three experiments involving stereotyping, bias, discrimination, and harmful output avoidance.

works.title: The Political Biases of ChatGPT
works.description: Administers 15 political-orientation instruments to ChatGPT and reports a consistent left-leaning classification across 14 tests despite the system's stated neutrality.

works.title: The political ideology of conversational AI: Converging evidence on ChatGPT's pro-environmental, left-libertarian orientation
works.description: Uses 630 statements and preregistered multilingual, negation, order, and formality checks to characterize ChatGPT's political orientation and implied electoral choices.

works.title: The Rise and Potential of Large Language Model Based Agents: A Survey
works.description: Synthesizes architectures, applications, societies, personality, and open problems for LLM agents, but values are only one peripheral behavioral issue.

works.title: The Touché23-ValueEval Dataset for Identifying Human Values behind Arguments
works.description: Releases 9,324 arguments from six domains, each annotated by three workers across 54 human values, enabling fine-grained value identification behind arguments.

works.title: The Unlocking Spell on Base LLMs: Rethinking Alignment via In-Context Learning
works.description: Provides token-level evidence for superficial alignment and introduces URIAL, a tuning-free in-context alignment method evaluated on JUST-EVAL-INSTRUCT.

works.title: Towards Few-Shot Identification of Morality Frames using In-Context Learning
works.description: Uses few-shot prompting to identify Moral Foundations and entity-level moral sentiment frames, reducing dependence on specialized human annotation.

works.title: Towards Measuring the Representation of Subjective Global Opinions in Language Models
works.description: Introduces GlobalOpinionQA and a country-conditioned similarity framework that reveals uneven representation of global opinions and stereotype risks under steering.

limitations: No dedicated code release for the paper was identified
Model outputs and analysis notebooks are not included with the dataset
Non-commercial share-alike terms limit some downstream uses
Historical proprietary model versions cannot be reconstructed

works.title: Training Socially Aligned Language Models on Simulated Social Interactions
works.description: Proposes learning societal value judgments through simulated social interaction and reports improved generalization, alignment benchmarks, and human evaluation.

works.title: TrustGPT: A Benchmark for Trustworthy and Responsible Large Language Models
works.description: Combines toxicity, intergroup bias, and active/passive value-alignment tasks in one benchmark for conversational language models.

works.title: UltraFeedback: Boosting Language Models with Scaled AI Feedback
works.description: Creates over one million multidimensional GPT-4 feedback annotations for 250k conversations and demonstrates their utility for preference optimization.

works.title: Value FULCRA: Mapping Large Language Models to the Multidimensional Spectrum of Basic Human Values
works.description: Defines an explicit multidimensional basic-value space for LLM behavior and contributes 5,000 output–Schwartz-vector pairs plus initial evaluation and alignment uses.

limitations: The trained value-evaluator checkpoint is not released
No pinned environment or end-to-end figure/table rebuild is documented
Some upstream data sources retain their own licenses

works.title: Value Kaleidoscope: Engaging AI with Pluralistic Human Values, Rights, and Duties
works.description: Central artifact for contextual value representation beyond a single axiology.
limitations: Most contextual values are initially generated by GPT-4, creating potential teacher structure despite human quality checks.
The abstract's 91% high-quality judgment does not describe coverage of omissions or rare values.

works.title: ValueDCG: Measuring Comprehensive Human Value Understanding Ability of Language Models
works.description: Separates value understanding into discrimination and critique and operationalizes their gap as a metric, revealing non-monotonic scaling across four LLMs.

works.title: Western, Religious or Spiritual: An Evaluation of Moral Justification in Large Language Models
works.description: Compares moral justification across Western, Abrahamic, and spiritual/mystic principle categories and identifies preference and permissibility asymmetries.

works.title: What does a Text Classifier Learn about Morality? An Explainable Method for Cross-Domain Comparison of Moral Rhetoric
works.description: Introduces Tomea for interpretable cross-domain comparison of learned moral rhetoric and validates it with crowd, classification, and qualitative studies.

works.title: What does ChatGPT return about human values? Exploring value bias in ChatGPT using a descriptive value theory
works.description: Probes ChatGPT with PVQ items, Schwartz definitions, and value names, then tests construct and discriminant validity of generated value content using a theory-driven dictionary.

works.title: Whose Opinions Do Language Models Reflect?
works.description: Creates OpinionsQA and a quantitative comparison against 60 US demographic groups, exposing large representation gaps that persist under demographic steering.

limitations: No explicit repository license
Pew-derived human responses have source-specific terms
Model querying relies on HELM plus historical proprietary endpoints
No pinned standalone environment

works.title: A Roadmap to Pluralistic Alignment
works.description: Defines Overton, steerable, and distributional pluralism together with three corresponding benchmark classes, establishing a widely useful conceptual map for pluralistic alignment.

limitations: No explicit repository license
Frozen model outputs are not released
Some tested models and APIs are gated or historical
One human comparison file remains externally hosted

works.title: A Survey on Evaluation of Large Language Models
works.description: Provides a broad and maintained taxonomy of LLM evaluation across tasks, benchmarks, and methods, but treats values only as a small part of societal evaluation.

works.title: A Survey on Human-Centric LLMs
works.description: Surveys individual and collective human simulation across behavioral and social-science applications, supplying context for values research without centering value constructs.

works.title: A Survey on Large Language Model based Autonomous Agents
works.description: Systematizes construction, application, and evaluation of LLM agents and maintains a broad reference repository, but does not focus on axiological properties.

works.title: Agent Alignment in Evolving Social Norms
works.description: Models agent alignment as evolutionary selection under changing social norms and evaluates whether agents track those norms while retaining task ability.

works.title: AI PERSONA: Towards Life-long Personalization of LLMs
works.description: Defines lifelong personalization, supplies a scalable adaptation framework, and proposes synthetic benchmarks for changing user profiles; values remain implicit.

works.title: AI Psychometrics: Assessing the Psychological Profiles of Large Language Models Through Psychometric Inventories
works.description: Formulates AI psychometrics and demonstrates repurposing human inventories to compare model personalities, values, beliefs, and biases while explicitly discussing interpretive limits.

works.title: Aligning Crowd Feedback via Distributional Preference Reward Modeling
works.description: Represents heterogeneous crowd preferences as distributions, updates them under preference shift, and calibrates reward learning with optimal transport.

works.title: Aligning Language Models with Demonstrated Feedback
works.description: DITTO converts fewer than ten demonstrations into iterative preference comparisons and improves customization across style and task domains.

works.title: Aligning Large Language Models with Diverse Political Viewpoints
works.description: Political viewpoints are a salient value domain, though the primary construct is viewpoint-conditioned generation rather than general value measurement.
limitations: Only an aggregated abstract source was available in this pass, so primary-source confirmation is pending.
Evidence is geographically and institutionally specific to Swiss party politics.

works.title: Aligning LLMs with Individual Preferences via Interaction
works.description: Trains models to infer unspoken preferences through dialogue using 3,310 personas, a tree-structured multi-turn dataset, and the ALOE evaluation benchmark.

works.title: Aligning to Thousands of Preferences via System Message Generalization
works.description: Creates 192,000 value combinations over 65,000 instructions and trains Janus to generalize from explicit system-message values to unseen preference configurations.

works.title: An image speaks a thousand words, but can everyone listen? On image transcreation for cultural relevance
works.description: Defines image transcreation, releases 700 culturally grounded evaluation images, and uses multifaceted human evaluation to expose severe cultural-relevance failures.

works.title: Are Large Language Models Chameleons? An Attempt to Simulate Social Surveys
works.description: Runs millions of European Social Survey simulations and develops distributional comparison methods, showing fundamental prompt, cultural, age, and gender sensitivity.

works.title: Are Large Language Models Consistent over Value-laden Questions?
works.description: Defines four forms of value consistency and evaluates 8,000 questions across 300 topics, languages, formats, paraphrases, and a 165-person comparison.

limitations: Fresh API generations and model-judge outputs may drift
Complete outputs are hosted separately on Google Drive

works.title: Are Large Language Models Moral Hypocrites? A Study Based on Moral Foundations
works.description: Compares Moral Foundations Questionnaire profiles with concrete vignette judgments and finds cross-instrument contradictions despite within-instrument consistency in GPT-4 and Claude 2.1.

works.title: Arithmetic Control of LLMs for Diverse User Preferences: Directional Preference Alignment with Multi-Objective Rewards
works.description: Represents user trade-offs as directions in multi-objective reward space and demonstrates arithmetic control of helpfulness and verbosity on Mistral-7B.

works.title: Assessing the Alignment of Large Language Models With Human Values for Mental Health Integration: Cross-Sectional Study Using Schwartz’s Theory of Basic Values
works.description: Directly tests Schwartz-based value profiling and transfer to decisions in a consequential deployment domain.
limitations: Anthropomorphized questionnaire prompting may not license claims about embedded motivational infrastructure.
Only four older model endpoints are evaluated, and the primary source still requires confirmation.

works.title: Attributing Culture-Conditioned Generations to Pretraining Corpora
works.description: Introduces MEMOed and traces food and clothing generations for 110 cultures to memorized pretraining entities, clarifying one source of cultural bias.

works.title: Automating Dataset Updates Towards Reliable and Timely Evaluation of Large Language Models
works.description: Develops mimicking and Bloom-taxonomy extension strategies for refreshing general benchmarks and controlling difficulty, useful evaluation infrastructure but not value-specific.

works.title: Axioms for AI Alignment from Human Feedback
works.description: Shows standard random-utility reward models violate social-choice axioms and develops linear social-choice aggregation rules with stronger formal guarantees.

works.title: BAPO: Base-Anchored Preference Optimization for Overcoming Forgetting in Large Language Models Personalization
works.description: Documents preference-heterogeneity-dependent forgetting and anchors optimization to base-model responses to preserve general knowledge during personalization.

works.title: Beyond Aesthetics: Cultural Competence in Text-to-Image Models
works.description: Creates CUBE-1K and a larger cultural artifact space spanning eight countries and evaluates both cultural awareness and diversity in text-to-image systems.

works.title: Beyond Human Norms: Unveiling Unique Values of Large Language Models through Interdisciplinary Approaches
works.description: ValueLex reconstructs a model-native value space from 30-plus LLMs through lexical elicitation, factor analysis, and semantic clustering, then builds projective tests for the resulting dimensions.

works.title: Beyond Partisan Leaning: A Comparative Analysis of Political Bias in Large Language Models
works.description: Evaluates 43 models without persona conditioning using separate partisan-orientation and engagement axes and clusters their political expression profiles.

works.title: Black-Box Prompt Optimization: Aligning Large Language Models without Model Training
works.description: Optimizes prompts from human preferences to align inaccessible black-box models and reports gains alone and in combination with PPO or DPO.

works.title: BLEnD: A Benchmark for LLMs on Everyday Knowledge in Diverse Cultures and Languages
works.description: Releases 52,600 human-crafted questions across 16 regions and 13 languages and quantifies large disparities in everyday cultural knowledge.

works.title: Bridging Cultural Nuances in Dialogue Agents through Cultural Value Surveys
works.description: Introduces cuDialog and incorporates dimensions from cultural value surveys into dialogue representations to test culturally conditioned generation.

works.title: CIVICS: Building a Dataset for Examining Culturally-Informed Values in Large Language Models
works.description: Builds a handcrafted multilingual corpus of value-laden social issues and evaluates both log-probability and long-form value expression across languages and sources.

works.title: CLAVE: An Adaptive Framework for Evaluating Values of LLM Generated Responses
works.description: Directly addresses scorer calibration and value detection in generated responses, a central L3 measurement issue.
limitations: The large concept-extraction model may inject shared-method bias into the labels and downstream evaluator.
Generalization across changing value definitions is claimed but its human-validation breadth is not visible in the abstract.

works.title: CLIcK: A Benchmark Dataset of Cultural and Linguistic Intelligence in Korean
works.description: Contributes 1,995 Korean-native questions with fine-grained cultural and linguistic annotations and benchmarks 13 models, but chiefly measures knowledge rather than values.

works.title: CMoralEval: A Moral Evaluation Benchmark for Chinese Large Language Models
works.description: Builds a Chinese morality taxonomy and more than 30,000 explicit and dilemma scenarios from culturally grounded media, newspapers, and scholarship with assisted human annotation.

works.title: ComPO: Community Preferences for Language Model Personalization
works.description: Introduces community-conditioned preference optimization and releases ComPRed, showing that meaningful community identifiers improve group-level personalization.

works.title: Controllable Preference Optimization: Toward Controllable Multi-Objective Alignment
works.description: Conditions optimization on explicit objective scores to control trade-offs among helpfulness, honesty, and harmlessness and reduce the multi-objective alignment tax.

works.title: Controllable Safety Alignment: Inference-Time Adaptation to Diverse Safety Requirements
works.description: Introduces natural-language safety configurations, an alignment method, a human-authored benchmark, and a controllability metric for adapting safety behavior to plural requirements at inference time.

works.title: Cultural Commonsense Knowledge for Intercultural Dialogues
works.description: MANGO distills 167,000 cultural assertions covering 30,000 concepts and 11,000 cultures and improves intercultural dialogue in human evaluation.

works.title: Cultural Conditioning or Placebo? On the Effectiveness of Socio-Demographic Prompting
works.description: Uses culturally sensitive and neutral prompts and datasets across four models to show that apparent cultural conditioning can be indistinguishable from arbitrary prompt perturbation.

works.title: Cultural Palette: Pluralising Culture Alignment via Multi-agent Palette
works.description: Uses five culturally specialized agents and gated parameter merging to compose country-conditioned responses from a multi-agent cultural representation.

works.title: Cultural Value Differences of LLMs: Prompt, Language, and Model Size
works.description: Separately tests question order, prompt language, and model size and finds that language and scale materially alter elicited cultural-value profiles.

works.title: CulturalBench: A Robust, Diverse, and Challenging Cultural Benchmark by Human-AI CulturalTeaming
works.description: Contributes 1,696 human-written and five-rater-verified questions spanning 45 regions and 17 topics, with a difficult subset that exposes major cultural-knowledge gaps.

works.title: Culturally Aware and Adapted NLP: A Taxonomy and a Survey of the State of the Art
works.description: Provides a fine-grained taxonomy of culture and systematically maps resources, methods, and research gaps in culturally aware NLP.

works.title: CulturalTeaming: AI-Assisted Interactive Red-Teaming for Challenging LLMs' (Lack of) Multicultural Knowledge
works.description: Develops human-AI cultural red-teaming and shows in workshops that model assistance helps annotators create difficult, culturally grounded evaluation questions.

works.title: CULTURE-GEN: Revealing Global Cultural Perception in Language Models through Natural Language Prompting
works.description: Maps generated cultural symbols for 110 countries across eight topics and quantifies representational diversity, defaults, and markers of marginalized cultures.

works.title: CultureBank: An Online Community-Driven Knowledge Base Towards Culturally Aware Language Technologies
works.description: Builds a public knowledge base of 23,000 contextualized cultural descriptors from community self-narratives and demonstrates evaluation and fine-tuning uses.

works.title: CultureLLM: Incorporating Cultural Differences into Large Language Models
works.description: Uses 50 World Values Survey seeds with validated semantic augmentation to train models for nine cultures and evaluates them on 60 cultural datasets.

works.title: CulturePark: Boosting Cross-cultural Understanding in Large Language Models
works.description: Generates 41,000 cross-cultural dialogues with multi-agent simulations and evaluates tuned models on moderation, Hofstede value alignment, and human cultural education.

works.title: DailyDilemmas: Revealing Value Preferences of LLMs with Quandaries of Daily Life
works.description: Provides 1,360 daily-life dilemmas with affected parties and action-linked values, analyzes choices through five theoretical frameworks, and tests whether system prompts can steer priorities.

limitations: Fresh API generations may differ from the released six-model outputs

works.title: Decoding Multilingual Moral Preferences: Unveiling LLM's Biases through the Moral Machine Experiment
works.description: Runs 6,500 Moral Machine dilemmas across five model families and ten languages and compares model moral trade-offs with culturally grouped human preferences.

works.title: DeNEVIL: Towards Deciphering and Navigating the Ethical Values of Large Language Models via Instruction Learning
works.description: The record is DeNEVIL, which dynamically elicits ethical vulnerabilities, releases 2,397 MoralPrompt items covering more than 500 principles, benchmarks models, and introduces VILMO alignment.

works.title: Diverging Preferences: When do Annotators Disagree and do Models Know?
works.description: Creates a ten-category disagreement taxonomy, shows that Bradley-Terry rewards and LLM judges mishandle systematic divergence, and proposes divergence detection for training and evaluation.

works.title: Do LLMs have Consistent Values?
works.description: Tests value rankings and correlations against psychological structure and demonstrates that apparent human-like consistency depends strongly on a specific value-anchoring prompt.

works.title: Do Moral Judgment and Reasoning Capability of LLMs Change with Language? A Study using the Multilingual Defining Issues Test
works.description: Extends the Defining Issues Test to five additional languages and finds large language-dependent differences in moral judgment and post-conventional reasoning across three models.

works.title: Does Cross-Cultural Alignment Change the Commonsense Morality of Language Models?
works.description: Compares English-preference, translated, and Japanese morality supervision and shows that some moral alignment transfers cross-lingually while culture-specific components do not.

works.title: DOSA: A Dataset of Social Artifacts from Different Indian Geographical Subcultures
works.description: Uses participatory collection with 260 people from 19 Indian subcultures to create 615 community-described artifacts and benchmark regional cultural familiarity.

works.title: Ethical Reasoning and Moral Value Alignment of LLMs Depend on the Language we Prompt them in
works.description: Directly shows that language changes measured moral-value behavior.
limitations: Only three models and six languages are named.
Normative-ethics task performance may not uniquely identify model values or cultural causes.

works.title: Evaluating Cultural Adaptability of a Large Language Model via Simulation of Synthetic Personas
works.description: Compares GPT-3.5 simulations with 7,286 human responses from 15 countries and separates the effects of nationality personas from native-language prompting.

works.title: Evaluating Large Language Models with Psychometrics
works.description: Builds a 13-dataset benchmark across personality, values, emotional intelligence, theory of mind, and self-efficacy and exposes discrepancies between self-report and scenario responses.

works.title: Evaluating Moral Beliefs across LLMs through a Pluralistic Framework
works.description: Combines 472 Chinese moral choices, preference rankings, and debate persistence to compare individualistic, collectivist, and gendered moral patterns across four models.

works.title: Evaluating the Prompt Steerability of Large Language Models
works.description: Formally defines prompt steerability over joint behavioral distributions and measures baseline skew, directional asymmetry, and steering effort across persona dimensions.

works.title: Exploring and steering the moral compass of Large Language Models
works.description: Compares dilemma and Moral Foundations profiles and introduces activation steering that causally shifts a model toward different ethical schools.

works.title: Exploring Changes in Nation Perception with Nationality-Assigned Personas in LLMs
works.description: Tests 193 nationality personas across four models and shows persistent regional favoritism, persona-induced in-group effects, and imperfect correspondence to human country evaluations.

works.title: Exploring Cross-Cultural Differences in English Hate Speech Annotations: From Dataset Construction to Analysis
works.description: Collects cross-cultural hate-speech labels in five countries and quantifies substantial disagreement, providing strong evidence that safety annotations encode cultural judgment.

works.title: Exploring Large Language Models on Cross-Cultural Values in Connection with Training Methodology
works.description: Relates cross-country cultural-value judgments to model size, multilingual corpus composition, alignment, and synthetic training data.

works.title: Exploring Multilingual Concepts of Human Value in Large Language Models: Is Value Alignment Consistent, Transferable and Controllable across Languages?
works.description: Maps seven value-concept directions across 16 languages and three model families, tests cross-lingual consistency and transfer, and demonstrates representation-level value control.

works.title: Extended Japanese Commonsense Morality Dataset with Masked Token and Label Enhancement, CIKM '24 (Short Paper)
works.description: Expands Japanese Commonsense Morality from 13,975 to 31,184 examples using masked replacement with relabeling and improves culturally specific moral classification.

works.title: Extrinsic Evaluation of Cultural Competence in Large Language Models
works.description: Moves cultural evaluation into open-ended QA and story generation and shows that nationality-conditioned lexical changes correlate only weakly with country-level cultural values.

works.title: Few-shot Personalization of LLMs with Mis-aligned Responses
works.description: Iteratively improves personalized prompts using user profiles, prior opinions, and model misalignment examples for few-shot preference adaptation.

works.title: Few-shot Steerable Alignment: Adapting Rewards and LLM Policies with Neural Processes
works.description: Extends preference modeling to latent heterogeneous objectives and conditions reward and policy parameters on a few user choices to span continuous behavioral modes.

works.title: FoodieQA: A Multimodal Dataset for Fine-Grained Understanding of Chinese Food Culture
works.description: Provides a carefully curated multimodal benchmark of regional Chinese food knowledge, but does not operationalize values or normative preferences.

works.title: Foundational Challenges in Assuring Alignment and Safety of Large Language Models
works.description: Organizes 18 broad assurance challenges and over 200 research questions, serving as general alignment context rather than focused value research.

works.title: From Distributional to Overton Pluralism: Investigating Large Language Model Alignment
works.description: Reassesses post-alignment diversity loss and shows that aligned outputs aggregate useful information but remain recoverable from base models, distinguishing distributional from Overton pluralism.

works.title: From Individual to Society: A Survey on Social Simulation Driven by Large Language Model-based Agents
works.description: Systematically maps individual, scenario, and society simulation architectures, objectives, datasets, and evaluations and maintains a companion repository.

works.title: Group Robust Best-of-K Decoding of Language Models for Pluralistic Alignment
works.description: Proposes inference-time best-of-K selection that maximizes the worst reward criterion when group trade-off weights are unknown and demonstrates the objective's behavior.

works.title: Group Robust Preference Optimization in Reward-free RLHF
works.description: Develops and theoretically analyzes worst-group robust direct preference optimization and improves the lowest-performing groups on global-opinion preference data.

works.title: Having Beer after Prayer? Measuring Cultural Bias in Large Language Models
works.description: Introduces CAMeL with 628 natural prompts and 20,368 Arab- and Western-associated entities and audits 16 models plus six Arabic pretraining corpora.

works.title: HelpSteer2: Open-source dataset for training top-performing reward models
works.description: Releases 10,000 permissively licensed, multi-attribute response pairs and demonstrates efficient state-of-the-art reward modeling and SteerLM 2.0 alignment.

works.title: High-Dimension Human Value Representation in Large Language Models
works.description: Directly changes the representation used for comparing value distributions across models, languages, and cultures.
limitations: The meaning and identifiability of learned dimensions are not clear from the abstract.
Self-supervision from model outputs may encode source-model and prompt structure.

works.title: How developments in natural language processing help us in understanding human behaviour, 2024.10 Nature Human Behavior
works.description: Reviews how computational language analysis complements surveys and hand coding for studying human psychology and behavior, with values as one possible application rather than the focus.

works.title: How large language models can reshape collective intelligence
works.description: Synthesizes how LLMs may alter idea generation, information aggregation, deliberation, preference aggregation, and diversity in collective decision systems.

works.title: How Well Do LLMs Represent Values Across Cultures? Empirical Analysis of LLM Responses Based on Hofstede Cultural Dimensions
works.description: Uses advice scenarios, five Hofstede dimensions, 36 country personas, and associated languages to distinguish recognition of cultural differences from actually value-conditioned advice.

works.title: Inducing Human-like Biases in Moral Reasoning Language Models
works.description: Tests behavioral and fMRI supervision for moral reasoning and compares model activations with human brain data, finding no significant BrainScore improvement from fine-tuning.

works.title: Interpretable Preferences via Multi-Objective Reward Modeling and Mixture-of-Experts
works.description: Builds an interpretable multi-objective reward model and context-sensitive gating network over objectives such as honesty, safety, and verbosity, reaching strong RewardBench performance.

works.title: Investigating Cultural Alignment of Large Language Models
works.description: Compares Arabic and English survey simulations with human Egyptian and U.S. data, varies pretraining mixtures, and introduces anthropological prompting for cultural alignment.

works.title: Investigating Human Values in Online Communities
works.description: Human-validates relevance and polarity classifiers and applies them to over six million posts in 12,000 communities to map Schwartz-value expression at scale.

works.title: KorNAT: LLM Alignment Benchmark for Korean Social Values and Common Knowledge
works.description: Separates 4,000 social-value from 6,000 knowledge questions and grounds Korean value targets in a statistically designed survey of 6,174 people.

works.title: Language Model Alignment in Multilingual Trolley Problems
works.description: Creates MultiTP in over 100 languages from the 40-million-response Moral Machine study and evaluates six moral dimensions across 19 models with paraphrase checks.

works.title: Language Models are Alignable Decision-Makers: Dataset and Application to the Medical Triage Domain
works.description: Introduces 62 medical-triage scenarios labeled with six decision-maker attributes, including fairness and moral desert, and demonstrates explicit zero-shot value steering plus weighted self-consistency.

works.title: Large Language Model based Multi-Agents: A Survey of Progress and Challenges
works.description: Systematically surveys LLM multi-agent environments, profiles, communication, capability development, datasets, and challenges, but does not center values.

works.title: Large Language Model Safety: A Holistic Survey
works.description: Offers a broad safety taxonomy spanning value misalignment, adversarial robustness, misuse, autonomous risks, agents, interpretability, industry roadmaps, and governance.

works.title: Large Language Models are not Fair Evaluators
works.description: Not a value study itself, but directly relevant to scorer and order dependence in L2/L3 value evaluation.
limitations: The headline evidence centers on one evaluator and one benchmark comparison.
Transfer of calibration to semantic value scorers is not established in the abstract.
No explicit repository license
No dependency/environment specification
No script that reconstructs the reported tables and figures
Closed evaluator APIs and historical model versions can drift

works.title: Large Language Models Empowered Personalized Web Agents
works.description: Defines personalized web agents, introduces PersonalWAB, and combines retrieved user history with fine-tuning and preference optimization for customized actions.

works.title: Large language models, social demography, and hegemony: comparing authorship in human and synthetic text
works.description: Compares over 150,000 human admissions essays with 25,000 model essays and finds synthetic writing resembles more socially privileged male authors and has reduced stylistic variation.

works.title: Large-scale moral machine experiment on large language models
works.description: Uses conjoint analysis to compare moral trade-offs in 52 models with human Moral Machine judgments and analyzes scale, architecture, and version effects.

works.title: Larger and more instructable language models become less reliable
works.description: A large Nature study separates correctness, avoidance, difficulty, and prompt stability and shows scaling and instruction shaping do not create a reliably safe operating region.

works.title: Llama meets EU: Investigating the European Political Spectrum through the Lens of LLMs
works.description: Audits EU political positioning and fine-tunes party-specific models on European Parliament speeches, showing substantial and measurable ideological steering.

works.title: LLM-GLOBE: A Benchmark Evaluating the Cultural Values Embedded in LLM Output
works.description: Adapts the validated GLOBE cultural framework to open-ended model outputs and compares Chinese and U.S. systems using an automated jury pipeline.

works.title: LLMs are Biased Teachers: Evaluating LLM Bias in Personalized Education
works.description: Introduces two bias metrics and audits more than 17,000 personalized educational explanations across nine models and multiple protected dimensions.

works.title: LLMs as mirrors of societal moral standards: reflection of cultural divergence and agreement across ethical topics
works.description: Triangulates variance, country-cluster agreement, and direct comparative prompts against survey data and finds weak, variable representation of cross-cultural moral patterns.

works.title: LLMs-as-Judges: A Comprehensive Survey on LLM-based Evaluation Methods
works.description: Systematizes LLM judging by functionality, methodology, application, meta-evaluation, and limitations, providing essential context for automated value scorers.

works.title: LocalValueBench: A Collaboratively Built and Extensible Benchmark for Evaluating Localized Value Alignment and Ethical Safety in Large Language Models
works.description: Develops an extensible local-value benchmark, ethical-reasoning typology, and interrogation method around Australian values as a template for regulators.

works.title: M5 -- A Diverse Benchmark to Assess the Performance of Large Multimodal Models Across Multilingual and Multicultural Vision-Language Tasks
works.description: Combines eight datasets, five vision-language tasks, and 41 languages and exposes large resource-dependent multimodal disparities, but primarily measures capability rather than values.

works.title: MallowsPO: Fine-Tune Your LLM with Preference Dispersions
works.description: Introduces a prompt-level preference-dispersion parameter that generalizes standard DPO and improves learning when human preferences vary.

works.title: MAP: Multi-Human-Value Alignment Palette
works.description: Formulates multi-value alignment as constrained optimization, analyzes feasibility and trade-offs theoretically, and solves user-specified value targets with a primal-dual method.

works.title: Mapping and Influencing the Political Ideology of Large Language Models using Synthetic Personas
works.description: Maps Political Compass distributions under synthetic personas and reveals asymmetric ideological steerability toward opposed political targets.

works.title: Massively Multi-Cultural Knowledge Acquisition & LM Benchmarking
works.description: Builds CultureAtlas by navigating cultural Wikipedia networks to cover sub-country regions and ethnolinguistic groups for knowledge extraction and benchmarking.

works.title: MaxMin-RLHF: Alignment with Diverse Human Preferences
works.description: Proves a limitation of single-reward RLHF, learns a mixture of preferences, and optimizes an egalitarian max-min objective that substantially improves minority-group outcomes.

works.title: Measuring Human and AI Values Based on Generative Psychometrics with Large Language Models
works.description: Central to open-ended L3 value scoring and alternatives to questionnaire-only profiling.
limitations: The parser/scorer can induce common-method structure and needs task-local human validation.
Stability and superiority claims require inspection of validation design and baselines.

works.title: Measuring Spiritual Values and Bias of Large Language Models
works.description: Measures spiritual-value profiles, links them to differential hate-speech sensitivity, and tests continued pretraining on spiritual texts as an intervention.

works.title: MetaAlign: Align Large Language Models with Diverse Preferences during Inference Time
works.description: Trains on a constructed meta-alignment dataset so models can follow explicit or implicit preferences supplied only at inference time.

works.title: MID-Space: Aligning Diverse Communities' Needs to Inclusive Public Spaces
works.description: Creates an ethically reviewed community preference dataset for visualizations of inclusive, diverse, and comfortable public spaces and demonstrates aligned image-generation potential.

works.title: MM-MoralBench: A MultiModal Moral Evaluation Benchmark for Large Vision-Language Models
works.description: Builds visual-dialogue dilemmas over six moral foundations and evaluates judgment, classification, and response behavior in more than 20 vision-language models.

works.title: Modular Pluralism: Pluralistic Alignment via Multi-LLM Collaboration
works.description: Combines a base model with modular community models to support Overton, steerable, and distributional pluralism and tests all three across six tasks and four datasets.

works.title: Moral Alignment for LLM Agents
works.description: Explicitly encodes deontological and utilitarian intrinsic rewards, fine-tunes agents in the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, and tests unlearning and cross-game generalization.

works.title: Moral Foundations of Large Language Models
works.description: Directly profiles a non-Schwartz axiological space and tests its context dependence.
limitations: Model, prompt, and human-comparison coverage are not specified in the abstract.
Prompt-induced moral expressions may not support claims about acquired internal values.

works.title: Moral Persuasion in Large Language Models: Evaluating Susceptibility and Ethical Alignment
works.description: Tests whether conversational persuaders shift initial moral decisions or induce adherence to named ethical frameworks and analyzes model, scenario, and dialogue-length effects.

works.title: MoralBench: Moral Evaluation of LLMs
works.description: Releases dilemmas, metrics, and ethics-scholar-informed qualitative evaluation for comparing contextual moral reasoning across language models.

works.title: MoralBERT: A Fine-Tuned Language Model for Capturing Moral Values in Social Discussions
works.description: Useful as a value-scoring model for human or AI text, though it does not primarily measure the values of LLMs.
limitations: Coverage is bounded by Moral Foundations Theory and social-media annotation schemes.
Out-of-domain validity across generated LLM text is not established in the abstract.

works.title: Morality is Non-Binary: Building a Pluralist Moral Sentence Embedding Space using Contrastive Learning
works.description: Learns a multi-element moral sentence space with contrastive supervision and shows that plural moral relationships require human labels rather than self-supervision alone.

works.title: Navigating the Cultural Kaleidoscope: A Hitchhiker's Guide to Sensitivity in Large Language Models
works.description: Contributes a cultural-harm test set and a diverse-annotator preference dataset and uses them to reduce culturally insensitive outputs through fine-tuning.

works.title: NormAd: A Framework for Measuring the Cultural Adaptability of Large Language Models
works.description: Separates adaptation from knowledge and evaluates 2,600 etiquette situations across 75 countries under abstract values, country cues, and explicit social norms with human baselines.

works.title: Not All Countries Celebrate Thanksgiving: On the Cultural Dominance in Large Language Models
works.description: Builds a benchmark covering concrete cultural objects and abstract values and demonstrates English-cultural defaults plus mitigation by diverse pretraining and culture-aware prompts.

works.title: OASIS: Open Agent Social Interaction Simulations with One Million Agents
works.description: Provides a scalable social-media simulator supporting up to one million agents and reproduces diffusion, polarization, and herd phenomena, but does not directly study value constructs.

works.title: PAD: Personalized Alignment of LLMs at Decoding-Time
works.description: Learns token-level personalized rewards and guides inference without retraining, generalizing to unseen preferences and multiple base models.

works.title: PAL: Pluralistic Alignment Framework for Learning from Heterogeneous Preferences
works.description: Uses ideal-point and mixture models to learn a shared latent preference space with few-shot user generalization and demonstrates efficient reward modeling across language and image tasks.

works.title: PAL: Sample-Efficient Personalized Reward Modeling for Pluralistic Alignment
works.description: Develops a modular personalized reward framework that separates shared and individual preference components and adapts to new users with as few as 20 labels while using far fewer parameters.

works.title: Persona-DB: Efficient Large Language Model Personalization for Response Prediction with Collaborative Data Refinement
works.description: Improves representation and collaborative refinement of user-history databases for context-efficient response prediction and cold-start personalization.

works.title: Personality Alignment of Large Language Models
works.description: Builds PAPI from more than 320,000 people across Big Five and Dark Triad inventories and introduces efficient activation intervention for personality-conditioned decisions.

works.title: Personalization of Large Language Models: A Survey
works.description: Unifies personalized generation and personalization applications through formal definitions and taxonomies of granularity, techniques, datasets, evaluation, and use cases.
