works.title: Personalized Adaptation via In-Context Preference Learning
works.description: Pretrains a history-dependent policy that adapts online to user feedback in context and demonstrates efficient personalization in contextual bandits.

works.title: Personalized Language Modeling from Personalized Human Feedback
works.description: Jointly learns a lightweight explicit-or-implicit user model and personalized policy, scaling beyond a homogeneous RLHF preference distribution.

works.title: Personalized Multimodal Large Language Models: A Survey
works.description: Surveys multimodal personalization architectures, training methods, tasks, metrics, datasets, and challenges without a focused normative or value component.

works.title: Personalizing Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback with Variational Preference Learning
works.description: Infers user-specific latent rewards and conditions policies on them, supporting heterogeneous preferences, uncertainty estimates, active learning, and pluralistic language evaluation.

works.title: PersonalLLM: Tailoring LLMs to Individual Preferences
works.description: Releases open-ended prompts, multiple high-quality answers, synthetic heterogeneous user models, and baselines for sparse-feedback personalization.

works.title: Plurals: A System for Guiding LLMs Via Simulated Social Ensembles
works.description: Provides a library of persona agents, deliberative structures, and moderators linked to government data, with six case studies and three randomized resonance experiments.

works.title: Policy Prototyping for LLMs: Pluralistic Alignment via Interactive and Collaborative Policymaking
works.description: Grounds an iterative stakeholder policy-design process in lessons from a real industrial LLM policymaking initiative and specifies four principles for pluralistic feedback loops.

works.title: Political Bias in LLMs: Unaligned Moral Values in Agent-centric Simulations
works.description: Repeatedly administers Moral Foundations items to political persona models and finds high variance and weak correspondence with human ideological groups, especially conservatives.

works.title: Political Compass or Spinning Arrow? Towards More Meaningful Evaluations for Values and Opinions in Large Language Models
works.description: Shows that Political Compass conclusions change with forced-answer mechanism, paraphrase, and open-ended format and derives broader recommendations for realistic value evaluation.

limitations: Fresh closed-model generations may differ from the frozen released completions

works.title: Political-LLM: Large Language Models in Political Science
works.description: Provides a multidisciplinary taxonomy and maintained resource for predictive, generative, simulation, causal, data, fine-tuning, and evaluation uses of LLMs in political science.

works.title: Position: Towards Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment
works.description: Reviews more than 400 papers and reframes alignment as a dynamic, bidirectional process that includes human adaptation, value modeling, long-term interaction, and mutual understanding.

works.title: POSIX: A Prompt Sensitivity Index For Large Language Models
works.description: Methodologically useful for value-instrument robustness, but not specific to values or alignment.
limitations: Intent preservation and meaningful output equivalence need independent validation.
Applicability to closed models and open-ended value scoring is not visible in the abstract.

works.title: PRISM: A Methodology for Auditing Biases in Large Language Models
works.description: Introduces indirect task-based inquiry for mapping positions that direct value questions may suppress and applies it across 21 models from seven providers.

works.title: ProgressGym: Alignment with a Millennium of Moral Progress
works.description: Builds 18 historical models from nine centuries of text and benchmarks following, predicting, and coevolving with moral change, with lifelong and extrapolative baselines.

works.title: Questioning the Survey Responses of Large Language Models
works.description: Tests 43 models on a Census survey and shows that ordering and label biases can produce apparently demographic profiles that collapse toward uniform responses after counterbalancing.

limitations: Some raw surveys have their own access and license conditions
Fresh proprietary-model calls may drift

works.title: Raising the Bar: Investigating the Values of Large Language Models via Generative Evolving Testing
works.description: Direct contribution to longitudinal and adaptive measurement of LLM value alignment.
limitations: Generated-item validity and the joint difficulty/conformity model require human and statistical validation.
The abstract does not state whether item generation is independent of evaluated models.

works.title: Random Silicon Sampling: Simulating Human Sub-Population Opinion Using a Large Language Model Based on Group-Level Demographic Information
works.description: Generates population opinion distributions from group-level demographics and evaluates subgroup- and topic-dependent correspondence with U.S. polls.

works.title: Recent Trends in Personalized Dialogue Generation: A Review of Datasets, Methodologies, and Evaluations
works.description: Reviews 22 datasets, 17 recent methods, five task types, and evaluation facets for personalized dialogue, without centering normative values.

works.title: RENOVI: A Benchmark Towards Remediating Norm Violations in Socio-Cultural Conversations
works.description: Releases 9,258 norm-annotated multi-turn dialogues and decomposes cultural norm remediation into sequential understanding and response tasks.

works.title: Representation Bias in Political Sample Simulations with Large Language Models
works.description: Quantifies language-, demographic-, and regime-dependent error in GPT-3.5 simulations of voting and public opinion across U.S., German, and Chinese surveys.

works.title: Representative Social Choice: From Learning Theory to AI Alignment
works.description: Formalizes sampled representation of large populations and issue spaces, proves generalization properties, proposes axioms, and derives new Arrow-like impossibility results for alignment.

works.title: Revealing Fine-Grained Values and Opinions in Large Language Models
works.description: Analyzes 156,000 responses to 62 propositions under 420 prompt variants and extracts recurrent rationale tropes beyond coarse Political Compass stances.

works.title: Revisiting the Reliability of Psychological Scales on Large Language Models
works.description: Runs 2,500 settings per model to test Big Five response consistency and the controllability of persona and group simulations.

works.title: Right vs. Right: Can LLMs Make Tough Choices?
works.description: Creates 1,730 dilemmas spanning four value conflicts and evaluates 20 models for sensitivity, consistency, consequence use, and explicit or implicit value steerability.

works.title: RLHF from Heterogeneous Feedback via Personalization and Preference Aggregation
works.description: Provides personalized and aggregate solutions to heterogeneous feedback with sample-complexity guarantees, utilitarian and leximin rules, probabilistic opinions, and strategy-proof mechanisms.

works.title: Rules, Cases, and Reasoning: Positivist Legal Theory as a Framework for Pluralistic AI Alignment
works.description: Uses the legal interaction of democratically produced rules and evolving cases to propose more concrete yet disagreement-preserving pluralistic alignment processes.

works.title: SafetyAnalyst: Interpretable, Transparent, and Steerable Safety Moderation for AI Behavior
works.description: Represents consequences in harm-benefit trees, exposes 28 steerable aggregation weights, and distills 18.5 million structured features into an open safety classifier.

works.title: SafeWorld: Geo-Diverse Safety Alignment
works.description: Builds thousands of human-verified queries grounded in cultural norms and law from 50 countries and 493 regions or groups, plus multidimensional evaluation and DPO alignment.

works.title: SaGE: Evaluating Moral Consistency in Large Language Models
works.description: Introduces Semantic Graph Entropy over inferred rules of thumb and a 50,000-example Moral Consistency Corpus, showing consistency is distinct from task accuracy.

works.title: Self-Alignment: Improving Alignment of Cultural Values in LLMs via In-Context Learning
works.description: Combines human survey distributions with in-context learning to shift cultural-value probe responses across five models and multiple test languages without training.

works.title: Self-Pluralising Culture Alignment for Large Language Models
works.description: CultureSPA generates cultural questions, contrasts aware and unaware responses, and tunes models jointly or culture-specifically on the resulting instances.

works.title: Social Choice Should Guide AI Alignment in Dealing with Diverse Human Feedback
works.description: Connects divergent RLHF and constitutional inputs to established preference-aggregation theory and develops a concrete social-choice research agenda for alignment.

works.title: STELA: a community-centred approach to norm elicitation for AI alignment
works.description: Develops and applies a four-stage community-centred process from theme sampling through norm elicitation, rule development, and participant review of an alignment ruleset.

works.title: Stick to your role! Stability of personal values expressed in large language models
works.description: Direct evidence that questionnaire profiles are context-conditioned and may not predict deployed behavior.
limitations: Simulated populations and PVQ prompting may conflate persona adherence with value stability.
Human longitudinal stability is only an imperfect reference for cross-context model stability.

works.title: Strong and weak alignment of large language models with human values
works.description: Distinguishes behavioral weak alignment from strong alignment requiring causal and intentional understanding, illustrates failures, and compares model and human value semantics.

works.title: The benefits, risks and bounds of personalizing the alignment of large language models to individuals
works.description: Develops a societal taxonomy balancing personalization's anti-hegemonic and utility benefits against profiling, privacy, bias reinforcement, manipulation, and vulnerable-user exploitation.

works.title: The Echoes of Multilinguality: Tracing Cultural Value Shifts during LM Fine-tuning
works.description: Tracks how fine-tuning data in one language shifts cultural values in other languages and uses training-data attribution to locate examples driving cross-lingual value bleed.

works.title: The Moral Mind(s) of Large Language Models
works.description: Applies revealed-preference rationality tests to nearly 40 models, estimates moral utility functions, and constructs a non-parametric similarity network of moral heterogeneity.

works.title: The Moral Turing Test: Evaluating Human-LLM Alignment in Moral Decision-Making
works.description: Creates matched human and model moral responses and uses a 230-person study to separate substantive agreement, perceived authorship, linguistic cues, and anti-AI bias.

works.title: The Multilingual Alignment Prism: Aligning Global and Local Preferences to Reduce Harm
works.description: Collects human red-team prompts distinguishing local from global harms and develops multilingual alignment across six languages with limited general-performance loss.

works.title: The Potential and Challenges of Evaluating Attitudes, Opinions, and Values in Large Language Models
works.description: Systematizes attitudes, opinions, and values across the entire evaluation pipeline and explicitly analyzes why different elicitation methods license different interpretations.

works.title: The PRISM Alignment Dataset: What Participatory, Representative and Individualised Human Feedback Reveals About the Subjective and Multicultural Alignment of Large Language Models
works.description: Links detailed profiles of 1,500 participants from 75 countries to preferences and fine-grained feedback in 8,011 live conversations with 21 models.

works.title: The Road to Artificial SuperIntelligence: A Comprehensive Survey of Superalignment
works.description: Surveys scalable oversight and hypothetical superalignment through sandwiching, self-enhancement, and weak-to-strong generalization rather than empirical human-value measurement.

works.title: The Self-Perception and Political Biases of ChatGPT
works.description: Repeatedly applies political, Big Five, MBTI, and Dark Factor instruments to ChatGPT and compares self-described ideological and personality profiles.

works.title: Towards Measuring and Modeling "Culture" in LLMs: A Survey
works.description: Audits more than 90 papers and shows that culture is rarely defined, instead being operationalized through demographic and semantic proxies with weak robustness and impact validation.

works.title: Towards Scalable Automated Alignment of LLMs: A Survey
works.description: Taxonomizes four sources of automated alignment signals and reviews mechanisms and feasibility when human supervision cannot scale.

works.title: Two Tales of Persona in LLMs: A Survey of Role-Playing and Personalization
works.description: Separates assigned role-playing personas from user-centered personalization, covers personality evaluation, and maintains a unified paper collection.

works.title: Unintended Impacts of LLM Alignment on Global Representation
works.description: Measures how alignment changes dialect, multilingual, and global-opinion representation and identifies both capability gains and new disparities from preference tuning.

works.title: Value Alignment from Unstructured Text
works.description: Provides an end-to-end synthetic-data pipeline for extracting implicit and explicit document values and aligning Mistral-7B to them in two use cases.

works.title: Value-Spectrum: Quantifying Preferences of Vision-Language Models via Value Decomposition in Social Media Contexts
works.description: Builds a Schwartz-based VQA benchmark over more than 50,000 short videos and evaluates both value-oriented responses and persona-induced adaptation in vision-language agents.

works.title: ValueBench: Towards Comprehensively Evaluating Value Orientations and Understanding of Large Language Models
works.description: A core benchmark for mapping axiologies, inventories, and value-related model capabilities.
limitations: Inventory aggregation may mix non-equivalent constructs and licenses without harmonized validity.
Six-model experiments are narrow relative to the benchmark's claimed comprehensiveness.

works.title: ValueCompass: A Framework for Measuring Contextual Value Alignment Between Human and LLMs
works.description: Directly addresses contextual rather than pooled value alignment.
limitations: The abstract does not quantify the value framework, human sample, or model panel.
Observed human-model differences may depend on scenario and elicitation design.

works.title: Vision-Language Models under Cultural and Inclusive Considerations
works.description: Collects culturally sensitive caption preferences from blind-user scenarios and shows both hallucination and misalignment between automatic metrics and human judgments.

works.title: Vox Populi, Vox AI? Using Language Models to Estimate German Public Opinion
works.description: Matches synthetic personas to German election respondents and shows GPT-3.5 fails aggregate and subgroup vote estimation despite capturing stereotypical partisan tendencies.

works.title: What are human values, and how do we align AI to them?
works.description: Core work on eliciting and aggregating plural human values into an AI alignment target.
limitations: The study covers one national population and three prompts.
LLM-mediated interviews can influence the values and relations that are elicited.

works.title: When large language models meet personalization: perspectives of challenges and opportunities
works.description: Surveys how LLM interfaces, planning, tools, and dialogue may transform personalization and outlines adaptation, privacy, fairness, and evaluation challenges.

works.title: Whose Morality Do They Speak? Unraveling Cultural Bias in Multilingual Language Models
works.description: Administers MFQ-2 across eight languages and six moral foundations to four multilingual models and documents substantial within-model cultural and linguistic variation.

works.title: WorldCuisines: A Massive-Scale Benchmark for Multilingual and Multicultural Visual Question Answering on Global Cuisines
works.description: Releases more than one million multilingual cuisine VQA examples across 30 languages and dialects, but measures cultural knowledge rather than values.

works.title: WorldValuesBench: A Large-Scale Benchmark Dataset for Multi-Cultural Value Awareness of Language Models
works.description: Transforms World Values Survey responses from 94,728 people into more than 20 million demographic-conditioned value-prediction examples with distributional evaluation.

works.title: You don't need a personality test to know these models are unreliable: Assessing the Reliability of Large Language Models on Psychometric Instruments
works.description: Tests 693 questions from 39 instruments and 115 persona axes across 17 models and finds severe option-order, wording, and negation instability.

limitations: No explicit code or dataset license
Only sample results are stored in GitHub; complete outputs depend on Google Drive
No pinned environment file was detected
Some source psychometric instruments may have separate reuse conditions

works.title: 'Too much alignment; not enough culture': Re-balancing cultural alignment practices in LLMs
works.description: Critiques demographic and benchmark proxies and proposes thick, context-anchored cultural outputs plus qualitative ethnographic evaluation.

works.title: A large-scale replication of scenario-based experiments in psychology and management using large language models
works.description: Replicates 156 experiments and finds high main-effect reproduction but inflated effects, false positives on nulls, and weaker sensitive-topic fidelity.

works.title: A Personalized Conversational Benchmark: Towards Simulating Personalized Conversations
works.description: Integrates personalized history and multi-user conversation across three tasks and ten Reddit-derived domains.

works.title: A Review of Incorporating Psychological Theories in LLMs
works.description: Organizes uses of theories from six psychology subfields by stages of LLM development.

works.title: A Sociotechnical Perspective on Aligning AI with Pluralistic Human Values
works.description: Collects 27,375 ratings from 1,095 U.S. and German participants to expose value conflicts, group variation, and reward-model limitations in feedback data.

works.title: A Survey on Personalized Alignment -- The Missing Piece for Large Language Models in Real-World Applications
works.description: Provides a unified survey framework spanning preference memory, personalized generation, feedback alignment, risks, and universal-value boundaries.

works.title: A Survey on Personalized and Pluralistic Preference Alignment in Large Language Models
works.description: Taxonomizes training-time, inference-time, and user-modeling methods alongside benchmarks and open problems.

works.title: A Theory of Response Sampling in LLMs: Part Descriptive and Part Prescriptive
works.description: Argues and tests that model samples blend statistical norms with an implicit prescriptive ideal that systematically biases decisions.

works.title: AdAEM: An Adaptively and Automated Extensible Measurement of LLMs' Value Difference
works.description: The central object is comparative measurement of LLM value orientations and their change over time.
limitations: Validity and claimed co-evolution depend on machine-generated items whose human grounding is not described in the abstract.
The abstract does not state safeguards against adaptive overfitting or evaluator-induced structure.

works.title: Algorithmic Fidelity of Large Language Models in Generating Synthetic German Public Opinions: A Case Study
works.description: Tests demographic persona fidelity against open-ended German election responses and exposes party- and prompt-variable asymmetries.

works.title: Aligning Multimodal LLM with Human Preference: A Survey
works.description: Surveys multimodal preference alignment by application, dataset construction, benchmarks, and future directions.

works.title: Aligning VLM Assistants with Personalized Situated Cognition
works.description: Operationalizes role-set cognition through an 18,000-instance action benchmark and a personalized action-based reward model.

works.title: Alignment Revisited: Are Large Language Models Consistent in Stated and Revealed Preferences?
works.description: Formalizes stated-revealed preference deviation and demonstrates widespread format-driven pivots in contextual binary choices.

works.title: Amulet: ReAlignment During Test Time for Personalized Preference Adaptation of LLMs
works.description: Formulates token decoding as closed-form online preference adaptation for training-free real-time personalization.

works.title: An Evaluation of Cultural Value Alignment in LLM
works.description: Compares questionnaire-derived outputs of ten models with human cultural-value scores across 20 countries and languages.

works.title: Analyzing the Ethical Logic of Eight Large Language Models
works.description: Triangulates self-described principles and five dilemmas through consequentialism, MFT, and Kohlberg frameworks across eight models.

works.title: Arbiters of Ambivalence: Challenges of Using LLMs in No-Consensus Tasks
works.description: Creates a no-consensus benchmark and shows that models collapse disagreement differently as generators, judges, and debaters.

works.title: Are LLMs (Really) Ideological? An IRT-based Analysis and Alignment Tool for Perceived Socio-Economic Bias in LLMs
works.description: Separates avoidance from answered-response ideology using item difficulty and challenges interpretations of non-engagement as political bias.

works.title: Are Rules Meant to be Broken? Understanding Multilingual Moral Reasoning as a Computational Pipeline with UniMoral
works.description: Unifies dilemmas, choices, ethical principles, factors, consequences, and annotator profiles in six languages across four moral-reasoning tasks.

works.title: Are the Values of LLMs Structurally Aligned with Humans? A Causal Perspective
works.description: Directly addresses value representation, human-model comparison, and controlled value steering.
limitations: Experiments named in the abstract cover only Gemma-2B-IT and Llama3-8B-IT.
The causal interpretation and graph identification assumptions require full-paper scrutiny.

works.title: Artificial Hivemind: The Open-Ended Homogeneity of Language Models (and Beyond)
works.description: Introduces 26,000 open-ended prompts, a diversity taxonomy, and 31,250 annotations to measure inter- and intra-model homogeneity and idiosyncratic preferences.

works.title: Benchmarking Distributional Alignment of Large Language Models
works.description: Benchmarks demographic opinion distributions across question domains, steering methods, expression methods, and human baselines.

works.title: Benchmarking Multi-National Value Alignment for Large Language Models
works.description: Builds NaVAB through scalable extraction, screening, and conflict-reduced generation of policy, legal, and moral values for five countries.

works.title: Benchmarking Overton Pluralism in LLMs
works.description: Formalizes viewpoint-set coverage, grounds it in a representative 1,208-person study, and builds an automated metric with high human rank correlation.

works.title: Better Aligned with Survey Respondents or Training Data? Unveiling Political Leanings of LLMs on U.S. Supreme Court Cases
works.description: Quantifies political patterns in pretraining corpora and finds model positions track them more than surveyed human opinions across 32 cases.

works.title: Beyond Benchmark: LLMs Evaluation with an Anthropomorphic and Value-oriented Roadmap
works.description: Organizes more than 200 benchmarks into IQ, EQ, PQ, and deployment-value dimensions with an implementation roadmap.

works.title: Break the Checkbox: Challenging Closed-Style Evaluations of Cultural Alignment in LLMs
works.description: Direct evidence that elicitation format changes inferred cultural and value alignment.
limitations: The meaning of stronger alignment in unconstrained settings is not validated in the abstract.
Coverage is anchored to two established cultural frameworks.

works.title: C-VARC: A Large-Scale Chinese Value Rule Corpus for Value Alignment of Large Language Models
works.description: Defines a 3-level Chinese value hierarchy, 250,000 human-enhanced rules, and 400,000 rule-based dilemmas for evaluating value conflicts across 17 models.

works.title: Can AI Truly Represent Your Voice in Deliberations? A Comprehensive Study of Large-Scale Opinion Aggregation with LLMs
works.description: Creates DeliberationBank from 7,500 participants and a human-aligned judge to audit representativeness, neutrality, and minority coverage across 18 LLMs.

works.title: Can Language Models Reason about Individualistic Human Values and Preferences?
works.description: Introduces WVS-derived IndieValueCatalog and a Value Inequity Index to test person-level value generalization beyond demographic buckets.

works.title: Can LLMs Grasp Implicit Cultural Values? Benchmarking LLMs' Cultural Intelligence with CQ-Bench
works.description: Builds validated conversational stories and graded attitude, selection, and extraction tasks for values implicit in WVS and GlobalOpinions content.

works.title: CARE: Multilingual Human Preference Learning for Cultural Awareness
works.description: Releases 3,490 culturally specific questions and 31,700 native-judged responses, showing small high-quality local feedback can outperform generic preference data.

works.title: CAReDiO: Cultural Alignment via Representativeness and Distinctiveness Guided Data Optimization
works.description: Optimizes cultural data for both within-culture coverage and cross-culture distinctiveness, reporting effective alignment with 200 examples across 15 cultures.

works.title: CLASH: Evaluating Language Models on Judging High-Stakes Dilemmas from Multiple Perspectives
works.description: Provides 345 high-stakes dilemmas and 3,795 value-diverse perspectives to test ambivalence, discomfort, temporal value shifts, and steerability across 14 models.

works.title: COIG-P: A High-Quality and Large-Scale Chinese Preference Dataset for Alignment with Human Values
works.description: Constructs over one million Chinese preference pairs and accompanying reward model and benchmark across six broad task domains.

works.title: CoSteer: Collaborative Decoding-Time Personalization via Local Delta Steering
works.description: Uses private local context deltas to steer a cloud model at decoding time without centralized fine-tuning.

works.title: Counterfactual Reasoning for Steerable Pluralistic Value Alignment of Large Language Models
works.description: Models value interdependence, prioritization, and behavior causally and uses counterfactual inference for fine-grained pluralistic steering.

works.title: Cross-cultural value alignment frameworks for responsible AI governance: Evidence from China-West comparative analysis
works.description: Combines temporal dilemmas, cultural fidelity, first-token distributions, and interpretable reasoning to audit more than 20 China- and West-origin models.

works.title: CulFiT: A Fine-grained Cultural-aware LLM Training Paradigm via Multilingual Critique Data Synthesis
works.description: Synthesizes multilingual cultural critiques, decomposes them into verifiable reward units, and contributes GlobalCultureQA for open-ended evaluation.

works.title: Cultural Alignment in Large Language Models Using Soft Prompt Tuning
works.description: Uses black-box differential evolution over soft prompts to align non-differentiable survey-derived cultural dimensions without changing model weights.

works.title: Cultural Learning-Based Culture Adaptation of Language Models
works.description: Fine-tunes on simulated culturally adapted social interactions and evaluates cultural-value shifts against WVS measurements across architectures.

works.title: Cultural tendencies in generative AI
works.description: Shows language-conditioned shifts in social orientation and cognitive style across GPT and ERNIE and demonstrates downstream advertising effects.

works.title: Cultural Value Alignment in Large Language Models: A Prompt-based Analysis of Schwartz Values in Gemini, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek
works.description: Directly profiles LLMs in Schwartz space, though the design is narrower than general measurement frameworks.
limitations: Cultural interpretation is inferred partly from model origin or training-language context rather than directly established.
Only three named model families and one questionnaire interface are represented.

works.title: Culture is Not Trivia: Sociocultural Theory for Cultural NLP
works.description: Connects recurring proxy, coverage, and static-benchmark failures to a sociocultural theory of culture and advocates contextual localization.

works.title: CultureSynth: A Hierarchical Taxonomy-Guided and Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Cultural Question-Answer Synthesis
works.description: Contributes a 12-domain, 130-topic taxonomy and 19,360-item multilingual cultural QA benchmark with 4,149 manually verified cases.

works.title: CURE: Cultural Understanding and Reasoning Evaluation - A Framework for "Thick" Culture Alignment Evaluation in LLMs
works.description: Replaces decontextualized correctness with situated cultural reasoning and four metrics that expose overestimation and instability in thin evaluations.

works.title: Decentralising LLM Alignment: A Case for Context, Pluralism, and Participation
works.description: Frames centralized alignment as epistemic governance and grounds context, pluralism, and participation in concrete use cases.

works.title: Decoding Alignment: A Critical Survey of LLM Development Initiatives through Value-setting and Data-centric Lens
works.description: Audits public documentation from six major model initiatives to compare how objectives, values, and data are selected and disclosed.

works.title: Deep Value Benchmark: Measuring Whether Models Generalize Deep Values or Shallow Preferences
works.description: Uses controlled train-test deconfounding and a human-validated metric to show nine models follow shallow attributes over underlying moral principles.

works.title: Diagnosing Moral Reasoning Acquisition in Language Models: Pragmatics and Generalization
works.description: Identifies a pragmatic dilemma in moral discourse as a generalization bottleneck shared by current moral-reasoning learning paradigms.

works.title: Distortion of AI Alignment: Does Preference Optimization Optimize for Preferences?
works.description: Defines worst-case pluralistic-alignment distortion and proves sharp separations among Nash learning, RLHF, and DPO under heterogeneous Bradley-Terry users.

works.title: Distribution Shift Alignment Helps LLMs Simulate Survey Response Distributions
works.description: Learns changes between background-conditioned survey distributions and reports large data savings across five public datasets.

works.title: Distributional Alignment for Social Simulation with LLMs: A Prompt Mixture Modeling Approach
works.description: Fits mixtures of system prompts using EM and gradient boosting to reproduce personality-trait and economic-behavior distributions.

works.title: Diverse Human Value Alignment for Large Language Models via Ethical Reasoning
works.description: Implements a five-stage, theory-grounded ethical deliberation process and evaluates regional norm identification on SafeWorld.

works.title: DIWALI: Diversity and Inclusivity aWare cuLture specific Items for India: Dataset and Assessment of LLMs for Cultural Text Adaptation in Indian Context
works.description: Provides roughly 8,000 culture-specific concepts over 17 facets and 36 Indian subregions with LLM and human adaptation evaluation.

works.title: Do Language Models Think Consistently? A Study of Value Preferences Across Varying Response Lengths
works.description: Directly compares short-form and multiple long-form value profiles and finds weak cross-format and cross-length consistency in five models.

works.title: Do Psychometric Tests Work for Large Language Models? Evaluation of Tests on Sexism, Racism, and Morality
works.description: Tests item and prompt reliability, convergent validity, and downstream ecological validity across 17 models, finding questionnaire scores often mispredict behavior.

works.title: Do Role-Playing Agents Practice What They Preach? Belief-Behavior Consistency in LLM-Based Simulations of Human Trust
works.description: Introduces belief-behavior consistency metrics and shows stated or imposed trust beliefs fail to predict role-play behavior at individual and population levels.

works.title: Drift: Decoding-time Personalized Alignments with Implicit User Preferences
works.description: Models preferences as interpretable attributes and steers frozen models with only 50–100 examples at decoding time.

works.title: Dual Mechanisms of Value Expression: Intrinsic vs. Prompted Values in Large Language Models
works.description: Separates shared and unique value vectors and neurons for intrinsic versus prompted expression, with cross-language and causal-behavior evidence.

works.title: EAVIT: Efficient and Accurate Human Value Identification from Text data via LLMs
works.description: Combines a local value detector with concise black-box adjudication and explanation-based training to reduce tokens while improving text value identification.

works.title: Embodied Agents Meet Personalization: Investigating Challenges and Solutions Through the Lens of Memory Utilization
works.description: Creates MEMENTO and a hierarchical user-memory module for personalized object semantics and routine-based embodied planning.

works.title: EMBRACE: Shaping Inclusive Opinion Representation by Aligning Implicit Conversations with Social Norms
works.description: Evaluates implicit conversational stances as proxies for normative opinion representation using both online classifiers and instruction-tuned models.

works.title: Emergent Moral Representations in Large Language Models Aligns with Human Conceptual, Neural, and Behavioral Moral Structure
works.description: Triangulates moral-foundation decoding, representational geometry, human judgments, and fMRI structure, locating strongest convergence in model mid-layers.

works.title: EmpathyAgent: Can Embodied Agents Conduct Empathetic Actions?
works.description: Introduces 10,000 multimodal cases, empathetic action plans, and process metrics for embodied support behavior.

works.title: Evaluating and Improving Cultural Awareness of Reward Models for LLM Alignment
