works.title: ValuePilot: A Two-Phase Framework for Value-Driven Decision-Making
works.description: Generates and curates multi-value scenarios, then trains a decision module to recognize values and navigate personalized trade-offs among feasible actions.

works.title: Values in the Wild: Discovering and Analyzing Values in Real-World Language Model Interactions
works.description: Derives a bottom-up taxonomy of 3,307 values from hundreds of thousands of deployed Claude interactions and maps their context-dependent expression at unprecedented scale.

works.title: VITAL: A New Dataset for Benchmarking Pluralistic Alignment in Healthcare
works.description: Releases 13,100 value-laden healthcare situations and 5,400 multiple-choice questions and demonstrates systematic shortcomings of pluralistic alignment methods across eight models.

works.title: What does AI consider praiseworthy?
works.description: Measures normative approval, criticism, and neutrality in realistic reactions to user intentions across politics, ethics, and world leaders rather than relying on direct value self-report.

works.title: What's the most important value? INVP: INvestigating the Value Priorities of LLMs through Decision-making in Social Scenarios
works.description: Directly measures value trade-offs through choices and is an important contrast to questionnaire profiling.
limitations: The abstract does not describe scenario authorship, counterbalancing, order effects, or human validation.
Binary alternatives may introduce dominance and mapping confounds.

works.title: When Harry Meets Superman: The Role of The Interlocutor in Persona-Based Dialogue Generation
works.description: Studies how interlocutor persona disclosure affects dialogue imitation and speaker identification, with no explicit normative or axiological construct.

works.title: When Personalization Meets Reality: A Multi-Faceted Analysis of Personalized Preference Learning
works.description: Evaluates eight personalization methods across three datasets for accuracy, fairness, adaptability, and safety, finding large performance differences and up to 20% safety misalignment.

works.title: Whispers of Many Shores: Cultural Alignment through Collaborative Cultural Expertise
works.description: Routes queries among soft-prompt cultural experts and reports large cultural-sensitivity gains without modifying the base model.

works.title: Whose Values? Measuring the (Subjective) Expression of Basic Human Values in Social Media
works.description: Collects 32,370 annotations from 1,079 people on 5,211 posts and personalizes Schwartz-value classifiers to explicitly model disagreement in perceived value expression.

works.title: Whose View of Safety? A Deep DIVE Dataset for Pluralistic Alignment of Text-to-Image Models
works.description: Creates an intersectionally rated multimodal safety dataset over 1,000 prompts and empirically maps demographic differences in harm perceptions and steerability.

works.title: Wide Reflective Equilibrium in LLM Alignment: Bridging Moral Epistemology and AI Safety
works.description: Connects wide reflective equilibrium to dynamic revision, procedural legitimacy, and justification of AI value alignment, offering a direct moral-epistemic framework.

works.title: Will AI Tell Lies to Save Sick Children? Litmus-Testing AI Values Prioritization with AIRiskDilemmas
works.description: Builds LitmusValues and AIRiskDilemmas to infer value priorities from forced trade-offs and shows that those priorities predict seen and unseen risky behavior.

works.title: A Method for Learning Value Systems in Generative AI
works.description: Direct computational representation and learning of value systems from generative-AI preferences.
limitations: Weighted linear scalarization may not represent non-compensatory or incommensurable values.
Preference datasets may not identify stable value groundings without strong assumptions.

works.title: A roadmap for evaluating moral competence in large language models
works.description: Highly relevant to construct validity of moral/value claims, though it is a Perspective rather than a value dataset or profiler.
limitations: The roadmap itself does not empirically validate the proposed evaluation suite.
Mechanistic moral competence may remain underdetermined by behavioral tests.

works.title: A Roadmap to Impactful Pluralistic Alignment Research
works.description: Directly addresses whether pluralistic value alignment research changes deployed systems.
limitations: Public documents may not fully reveal internal training and evaluation goals.
The roadmap's prescriptions are not tested in production systems.

works.title: A Scalable Approach to Evaluating Moral Sensitivity in LLMs
works.description: Tests robustness of moral feature identification, adjacent to but distinct from profiling value priorities.
limitations: Procedural templates and foundation-pole coverage may constrain moral complexity.
Semantic stability of listed features does not establish appropriate weighting or action.

works.title: A Survey of Progress in LLM Alignment From the Perspective of Reward Design
works.description: Reward design operationalizes preferences and principles, but the review is broader than explicit axiology or value measurement.
limitations: Systematic search, inclusion, and quality-appraisal methods are not visible in the abstract.
The value construct is often implicit in reward and preference terminology.

works.title: A Unified Moral-Value Dataset for Instruction Tuning
works.description: Direct artifact for moral/value instruction tuning and cross-dataset synthesis.
limitations: Heterogeneous source constructs and licenses may not be harmonized by format conversion.
The abstract describes results as preliminary and does not quantify dataset composition.

works.title: A validity-guided workflow for robust large language model research in psychology
works.description: Directly applicable to questionnaire, persona, and value-construct research, although it covers AI psychology broadly.
limitations: The workflow's effectiveness across completed studies is not validated in the abstract.
Its illustrative selfhood example may not cover all value-measurement interfaces.

works.title: ACE-Align: Attribute Causal Effect Alignment for Cultural Values under Varying Persona Granularities
works.description: Direct work on cultural-value representation, heterogeneity, and alignment.
limitations: Causal identification from persona prompting may rely on untestable assumptions.
Four demographic attributes and fourteen countries cannot cover within-culture heterogeneity comprehensively.

works.title: Adaptive Pluralistic Alignment: A pipeline for dynamic artificial democracy
works.description: Direct representation and reconciliation of evolving heterogeneous human values.
limitations: Evidence is a proof of concept using simulated historical annotators.
Voting rules and fixed reward bases can embed normative choices and miss new value dimensions.

works.title: Affective Computing in the Era of Large Language Models: A Survey from the NLP Perspective
works.description: Emotion and affect are neighboring constructs rather than direct AI-value representation or measurement.
limitations: The survey's completeness and systematicity cannot be judged from the abstract.
Affect, preference, safety, and values should not be treated as interchangeable constructs.

works.title: Agent-ValueBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Agent Values
works.description: Directly extends value profiling from text-only LLMs to deployed agent systems and exposes harness-conditioned values.
limitations: Co-synthesized tasks and rubric judges may share generator or evaluator structure.
The unusually broad 332-dimension taxonomy requires harmonization and validation scrutiny.

works.title: AI Agents Alone Are Not (Yet) Sufficient for Social Simulation
works.description: Relevant warning for value/opinion simulation, though not a value measurement contribution.
limitations: The position's prescribed design actions are not empirically validated in the abstract.
Generality across different social-simulation architectures is untested.

works.title: AI Alignment Breaks at the Edge
works.description: Directly argues for preserving multidimensional and plural value structure rather than scalar pooling.
limitations: The pilot has only 91 cases and four models.
Operational edge signals and governance effects remain proposals.

works.title: AI Alignment From Social Choice Perspectives
works.description: Central to reconciliation of heterogeneous values and preferences into alignment objectives.
limitations: Review methodology and coverage are not described.
Social-choice formalizations can omit preference elicitation and interpersonal-comparison problems.

works.title: AI and My Values: User Perceptions of LLMs' Ability to Extract, Embody, and Explain Human Values from Casual Conversations
works.description: Directly tests whether users interpret conversational value models as understanding and aligned embodiment.
limitations: Twenty participants are insufficient for broad population claims.
Perceived understanding can diverge from faithful value inference or user welfare.

works.title: Aligning Language Models from User Interactions
works.description: Learns user preferences implicitly, but does not explicitly identify or validate human value constructs.
limitations: Follow-up messages can express correction, style, or task information rather than stable preferences.
Deployment logs raise representation, privacy, and feedback-selection concerns.

works.title: Aligning Machiavellian Agents: Behavior Steering via Test-Time Policy Shaping
works.description: Directly steers agent ethical attributes and power-seeking behavior, though not a general value taxonomy.
limitations: Primary-source abstract confirmation is pending.
Alignment depends on the validity and coverage of scenario-action attribute classifiers.

works.title: AlpsBench: An LLM Personalization Benchmark for Real-Dialogue Memorization and Preference Alignment
works.description: Relevant to user preferences and inferred traits, but broader and more operational than human-value modeling.
limitations: WildChat users and conversations may not represent stable individuals or consented longitudinal profiles.
Structured memories can encode annotator interpretation of implicit preferences.

works.title: APM: Evaluating Style Personalization in LLMs with Arbitrary Preference Mappings
works.description: Useful measurement design for preferences, but targets style rather than axiological or moral values.
limitations: Random mappings improve identifiability at the cost of ecological realism.
Only two base-model families are named.

works.title: Apparent Psychological Profiles of Large Language Models are Largely a Measurement Artifact
works.description: Direct challenge to the validity of questionnaire-derived value and psychological profiles.
limitations: The strength of the conclusion depends on the variance model, instrument battery, and response-format assumptions.
Full-paper replication and separation of bias from genuine model differences are essential.

works.title: APS: Bias-Controlled Adaptive Prototype Simulation for Population-Scale LLM Agents
works.description: Can scale value/opinion simulations, but does not itself validate or measure value representation.
limitations: Agreement with a full-LLM reference does not establish agreement with human populations.
Local propagation can smooth rare or high-curvature subgroups despite protections.

works.title: Are Language Models Sensitive to Morally Irrelevant Distractors?
works.description: Direct evidence against treating elicited moral preferences as stable across irrelevant context.
limitations: The abstract does not describe independent validation that every distractor is morally irrelevant.
Sixty distractors may not cover natural deployment contexts.

works.title: Are LLMs Bad at Moral Reasoning?
works.description: Relevant to what moral-evaluation scores license, though centered on competence rather than value profiles.
limitations: Changing the task may test rubric imitation rather than deployed moral reasoning.
Claims about human rubric departures and calibration need independent adjudication.

works.title: Assessing the Reliability of Persona-Conditioned LLMs as Synthetic Survey Respondents
works.description: Direct validity evidence for persona-conditioned value-survey simulation.
limitations: Only two model families and U.S. WVS microdata are named.
Agreement with recorded survey answers may not exhaust synthetic-agent validity.

works.title: Beyond Arrow's Impossibility: Fairness as an Emergent Property of Multi-Agent Collaboration
works.description: Relevant to value conflict and social-choice aggregation in agent systems, but focused on one fairness domain.
limitations: A single structured triage environment may not generalize to decentralized governance.
Invoking Arrow's theorem does not by itself validate the specific negotiation process.

works.title: Beyond Independent Labels: Schwartz-Geometry Decoding for Human Value Detection
works.description: Directly improves value detection by preserving relations among Schwartz dimensions rather than independent labels.
limitations: Coherence metrics are introduced by the same work and require external validation.
One classifier backbone and one LLM diagnostic limit generality.

works.title: Beyond Isolated Behaviors: Hierarchical User Modeling for LLM Personalization
works.description: Stable dispositions can include values, but the evaluated construct is general personalization rather than axiology.
limitations: Mapping Bourdieu's constructs to computational components may be analogical rather than validated.
LaMP task improvements do not establish correct inference of deep dispositions.

works.title: Beyond Marginal Distributions: A Framework to Evaluate the Representativeness of Demographic-Aligned LLMs
works.description: Directly relevant to whether value-survey outputs reproduce coherent population value structures.
limitations: Correlation agreement does not establish causal or individual-level representativeness.
Results may be specific to WVS and the two steering techniques.

works.title: Beyond Self-Interest: Modeling Social-Oriented Motivation for Human-like Multi-Agent Interactions
works.description: Directly represents social motivation and value trade-offs in multi-agent behavior.
limitations: Human-likeness evaluators and baselines are not described in the abstract.
Reflective LLM updates may generate plausible rather than stable motivational states.

works.title: Beyond Value Benchmarks: Measuring Value-Structure Alignment in Large Language Models via Symmetric Q-Sorts
works.description: Symmetric Q-sorts and factor-geometry comparison add structural value alignment beyond itemwise agreement.

works.title: Bridging Values and Behavior: A Hierarchical Framework for Proactive Embodied Agents
works.description: ValuePlanner explicitly links value trade-offs, symbolic subgoals, and grounded long-horizon action.

works.title: Can LLMs Imagine Moral Alternatives Beyond Binary Dilemmas?
works.description: The dataset tests compromise and reframing rather than accepting a benchmark's binary moral choice space.

works.title: Can Persona-Prompted LLMs Emulate Subgroup Values? An Empirical Analysis of Generalisability and Fairness in Cultural Alignment
works.description: Tests subgroup-level WVS fidelity, OOD generalization, and fairness rather than national averages.

works.title: Can Revealed Preferences Clarify LLM Alignment and Steering?
works.description: Recovers decision costs from model choices and tests coherence, self-report fidelity, and steerability.

works.title: CCBENCH: Assessing LLM Cultural Competence via Implicitly Signaled Norms using Health Queries
works.description: Evaluates adaptation to implicit norm adherence across 3,120 health interactions and six cultures.

works.title: Characterizing the ability of LLMs to recapitulate Americans' distributional responses to public opinion polling questions across political issues
works.description: Distribution prompting offers a cheaper and more predictable alternative to simulated individual respondents.

works.title: Coherence Maximization Improves Pluralistic Alignment
works.description: Identifies cross-example coherence as a value-specification property and tests it across four task types.

works.title: Communication-Efficient Desire Alignment for Embodied Agent-Human Adaptation
works.description: Models latent desires and communication efficiency in embodied assistance.

works.title: Constitutional Value Potentials: reading and steering internal priority margins in language models
works.description: Reads pairwise constitutional priorities as activation-space margins and connects monitoring to intervention.

works.title: Context-Value-Action Architecture for Value-Driven Large Language Model Agents
works.description: Uses human-grounded dynamic value activation to combat population polarization over 1.1M traces.

works.title: Controllable Value Alignment in Large Language Models through Neuron-Level Editing
works.description: Defines value leakage and uses sparse neuron editing for more specific Schwartz-value steering.

works.title: CoPA: Benchmarking Personalized Question Answering with Data-Informed Cognitive Factors
works.description: Data-mined preference divergence yields six factor-level personalization dimensions and 1,985 profiles.

works.title: Cultural Adaptation in Large Language Models for Political Discourse
works.description: Provides a three-level adaptation taxonomy and evaluation matrix for culturally faithful political NLP.

works.title: Cultural Value Alignment Via Latent Activation Steering in Large Language Models
works.description: Maps latent cultural coordinates from 300 behavioral dilemmas and tests activation steering and entanglement.

works.title: Culturally Grounded Personas in Large Language Models: Characterization and Alignment with Socio-Psychological Value Frameworks
works.description: Triangulates synthetic personas against WVS, Inglehart-Welzel geometry, and Moral Foundations Theory.

works.title: CultureForest: Understanding and Evaluating Cultural Norm Grounded Reasoning in LLMs
works.description: A 5,378-item, 53-region benchmark separates cultural knowledge acquisition from grounded use.

works.title: CuMA: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Cultural Values via Demographic-Aware Mixture of Adapters
works.description: Treats cultural alignment as conditional capacity separation and tests against dense and semantic-only mixtures.

works.title: D2VBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models with Value Dilemmas in Daily Scenarios
works.description: Provides 10,000 mixed-format daily dilemmas over 158 manually annotated value concepts.

works.title: Distribution-First Population Simulation: Collapse, Calibration, and Recall in Non-WEIRD LLM Persona Modeling
works.description: Quantifies independent-agent collapse, sampling over-dispersion, weak behavior transfer, and memorization on real non-WEIRD microdata.

works.title: Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook
works.description: DOVE compares human and model free-text distributions through a learned codebook and unbalanced optimal transport.

works.title: Do Schwartz Higher-Order Values Help Sentence-Level Human Value Detection? A Study of Hierarchical Gating and Calibration
works.description: Controlled comparisons show calibration and soft ensembling outperform rigid higher-order gating.

works.title: Does LLM Alignment Really Need Diversity? An Empirical Study of Adapting RLVR Methods for Moral Reasoning
works.description: Directly tests diversity-preserving versus reward-maximizing alignment on moral reasoning.

works.title: DVMap: Fine-Grained Pluralistic Value Alignment via High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping
works.description: Builds 56,152 high-consensus WVS mappings and a triple-generalization evaluation for demographic-value alignment.

works.title: EASE Configuration Facilitates A Reproducible Science of LLM Social Simulations
works.description: Modularizes environment, agent, engine, and evaluation choices into an open reproducible simulation sandbox.

works.title: EconSimulacra: A Digital Twin Platform of Socio-Economic Systems Powered by LLM Agents
works.description: Couples economic, mobility, and social domains through shared agent state in an integrated simulator.

works.title: Evaluating Pluralism in LLMs through Latent Perspectives
works.description: Unsupervised multi-layer perspective extraction measures free-text pluralistic gaps and rare-view underrepresentation.

works.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Persona Simulation in Opinion Prediction with GPT-4.1
works.description: Tests one frontier model on election and health-opinion persona prediction.

works.title: Event-Centric Human Value Understanding in News-Domain Texts: An Actor-Conditioned, Multi-Granularity Benchmark
works.description: NEVU adds actor, event, direction, four granularities, and 168,061 value instances to news value detection.

works.title: Every Act Has Its Price: Compressed Moral Composition in Frontier LLMs
works.description: Calibrates component moral acts before testing non-additive composition across ten models.

works.title: From Correctness to Preference: A Framework for Personalized Agentic Reinforcement Learning
works.description: Separates task and user rewards and links preference identification, RL, and skill memory.

works.title: From Demographics to Survey Anchors: Evaluating LLM Agents for Modeling Retirement Attitudes
works.description: Shows survey-anchored agents reproduce errors and interactions missed by demographics-only personas.

works.title: From Empathy to Personalized Empathy: Adapting Empathetic Strategies to Individual Users
works.description: Introduces long-history personalized-empathy data and dynamic reward criteria.

works.title: From Recall to Forgetting: Benchmarking Long-Term Memory for Personalized Agents
works.description: Memora tests remembering, reasoning, recommending, and obsolete-memory penalties over long conversations.

works.title: From Sycophantic Consensus to Pluralistic Repair: Why AI Alignment Must Surface Disagreement
works.description: Defines scoping, signaling, repair, and a Pluralistic Repair Score with a two-model pilot.

works.title: From Volume to Value: Preference-Aligned Memory Construction for On-Device RAG
works.description: EPIC makes preference relevance the selection and retrieval criterion under severe on-device constraints.

works.title: Growth First, Care Second? Tracing the Landscape of LLM Value Preferences in Everyday Dilemmas
works.description: Inductively derives dilemma value networks and identifies cross-model growth-over-care preference homogenization.

works.title: How do LLMs reflect human moral foundations? a study using the moral foundations framework
works.description: Compares MFQ profiles with 461 students and tests prompt interventions across moral foundations.

works.title: How do Role Models Shape Collective Morality? Exemplar-Driven Moral Learning in Multi-Agent Simulation
works.description: Uses controlled games and motivational ablations to study exemplar-driven value convergence.

works.title: Human Values in a Single Sentence: Moral Presence, Hierarchies, and Transformer Ensembles on the Schwartz Continuum
works.description: A compute-controlled study establishes calibrated value-presence and nineteen-value baselines over 74K sentences.

works.title: Identifying and Understanding Human Values in Text: A Tailorable LLM-based Architecture
works.description: Separates theory specification, detection, and graded support/resistance into a reusable multi-axiology scorer.

works.title: Improving Cross-Cultural Survey Simulation with Calibrated Value Personas
works.description: Samples personas from observed cultural value distributions and calibrates diversity for population predictions.

works.title: Incoherent Values? Probing LLM Preferences Through Parametric Variation
works.description: Parametric dominance tests directly challenge claims that forced-choice preferences form a coherent value core.

works.title: Know You Before You Speak: User-State Modeling for LLM Personalization in Multi-Turn Conversation
works.description: PUMA models latent user-state dynamics and prospective actions in counseling dialogues.

works.title: Language Models Don't Know What You Want: Evaluating Personalization in Deep Research Needs Real Users
works.description: Real-user interviews expose nine personalization errors missed by synthetic users and LLM judges.

works.title: Large Language Models Should Learn Personalized Rather Than Aggregated Human Preferences
works.description: Synthesizes social-choice and safety arguments for bounded personalized alignment over average-user rewards.

works.title: Learning the Value Systems of Societies with Preference-based Multi-objective Reinforcement Learning
works.description: Jointly learns socially derived value groundings, clustered value systems, and Pareto policies in MDPs.

works.title: Learning to summarize user information for personalized reinforcement learning from human feedback
works.description: PLUS jointly learns interpretable user summaries and personalized reward predictions with new-user gains.

works.title: Lessons Without Borders? Evaluating Cultural Alignment of LLMs Using Multilingual Story Moral Generation
works.description: Human-written morals across fourteen language-culture pairs reveal accurate central tendencies but reduced value diversity.

works.title: LLM Alignment should go beyond Harmlessness–Helpfulness and incorporate Human Agency
works.description: Proposes the Flourishing-Justice-Autonomy framework and a participatory, dynamic alignment roadmap.

works.title: LLMs Contain Multitudes: How Deployment Context Reshapes Model-Level Preferences and Values
works.description: Over 1.2M decisions show deployment framing changes rankings and cardinal trade-offs far beyond ordinary prompt controls.

works.title: MATO: Multi-objective Personalized Alignment with Test-time Optimization for Large Language Models
works.description: Discovers natural-language objective rewards and dynamically balances them during decoding without retraining.

works.title: Measuring Human Value Expression in Social Media Texts: Calibrated LLM Annotation and Encoder Transfer
works.description: Calibrates Schwartz annotation against experts, preserves ambiguity, and quantifies regime effects over one million posts.

works.title: Measuring the Authority Stack of AI Systems: Empirical Analysis of 366,120 Forced-Choice Responses Across 8 AI Models
works.description: Maps values, evidence preferences, source trust, variant sensitivity, and retest reliability in one large forced-choice instrument.

works.title: Mechanistic Origin of Moral Indifference in Language Models
works.description: Combines 251K moral vectors, 23-model representation analysis, and targeted SAE topology reconstruction.

works.title: Meta-Learning Preferences for Multilingual LLM Alignment
works.description: Transfers reward and policy initialization to languages with only 100 preference samples and adds theory.

works.title: Mind the Gap in Cultural Alignment: Task-Aware Culture Management for Large Language Models
works.description: Separates culture adapters and routes task-specific web-grounded cultural knowledge across ten national cultures.

works.title: Mitigating Cross-Lingual Cultural Inconsistencies in LLMs via Consensus-Driven Preference Optimisation
works.description: Defines a hallucination-resilient consistency metric and mitigates prompt-language overwriting of explicit cultural identity.

works.title: Mitigating Cultural Bias in LLMs via Multi-Agent Cultural Debate
works.description: Adds an explicit neutral category and culturally represented debate with Chinese-English and Arabic testing.

works.title: MixDPO: Modeling Preference Strength for Pluralistic Alignment
works.description: Extends DPO with learned heterogeneous preference-strength distributions and subgroup checks.

works.title: Moral Lenses, Political Coordinates: Towards Ideological Positioning of Morally Conditioned LLMs
works.description: Treats moral endorsement as an intervention and measures robust value-specific ideological shifts.

works.title: Moral Semantics Survive Machine Translation: Cross-Lingual Evidence from Moral Foundations Corpora
works.description: Four validation methods support inexpensive Polish transfer of roughly 50K moral-foundation annotations.

works.title: Moral Sensitivity in LLMs: A Tiered Evaluation of Contextual Bias via Behavioral Profiling and Mechanistic Interpretability
works.description: Links a seven-tier behavioral bias index to circuit-level interventions across capability tiers.

works.title: More Context, Larger Models, or Moral Knowledge? A Systematic Study of Schwartz Value Detection in Political Texts
works.description: Factorially compares context, RAG knowledge, model scale, fusion, and per-value effects for Schwartz detection.

works.title: NextQuill: Causal Preference Modeling for Enhancing LLM Personalization
works.description: Targets causal preference effects and preference-bearing tokens instead of indiscriminate personalization fine-tuning.

works.title: Normative Robustness as a Frontier for Non-Verifiable Reasoning in LLMs
works.description: A 48K multi-turn adversarial study quantifies order, duration, distractor, and user-view effects on moral deliberation.

works.title: On the Alignment of Large Language Models with Global Human Opinion
works.description: Extends WVS opinion alignment across countries, prompt languages, and historical periods with released artifacts.

works.title: On the Credibility of Evaluating LLMs using Survey Questions
works.description: Directly tests the credibility and protocol sensitivity of LLM value-survey measurement.
limitations: Evidence is limited to WVS, three languages, and five countries in the abstract.
The abstract does not establish external validation of self-correlation distance beyond the reported study.

works.title: Open Problems in Differentiable Social Choice: Learning Mechanisms, Decisions, and Alignment
works.description: Synthesizes differentiable mechanisms through classical axioms and defines eighteen research problems.

works.title: Opinion dynamics and mutual influence with LLM agents through dialog simulation
works.description: Maps LLM dialogue histories to DeGroot and Friedkin-Johnsen opinion dynamics.

works.title: Overton Pluralistic Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
works.description: Trains implicit multi-perspective generation with coverage and uniqueness rewards rather than explicit prompting.

works.title: P-GenRM: Personalized Generative Reward Model with Test-time User-based Scaling
works.description: Introduces adaptive persona-and-rubric reward chains plus individual- and prototype-level test-time scaling for sparse personalized feedback.

works.title: Parametric Social Identity Injection and Diversification in Public Opinion Simulation
works.description: Diagnoses representation-level diversity collapse and injects demographic and value-orientation vectors to improve WVS population fidelity.

works.title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
works.description: Provides matched retained-experience interventions and pathway diagnostics for persistent agents across 204 episodes.

works.title: Persona-Based Simulation of Human Opinion at Population Scale
works.description: Builds psychologically grounded semi-structured personas from social traces and validates population-scale opinion simulation against a representative panel.

works.title: Personalized Benchmarking: Evaluating LLMs by Individual Preferences
works.description: Shows strong divergence between aggregate and user-specific model rankings and relates it to query topic and style features.

works.title: Personalized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Heterogenous Preference Alignment
works.description: Replaces batch-wide GRPO normalization with preference-group reward histories to preserve heterogeneous alignment signals.

works.title: Personalized Reasoning: Just-in-time Personalization and Why LLMs Fail at It
works.description: Defines personalized reasoning and introduces PREFDISCO, revealing systematic failures to elicit and use sparse user preferences across 21 models.

works.title: Personalized RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models with Human Aligned Personalization
works.description: Creates rubric-controlled response pairs and demonstrates stronger correlation with personalized downstream BoN and PPO performance than general RM benchmarks.

works.title: PersonaVLM: Long-Term Personalized Multimodal LLMs
works.description: Combines chronological multimodal memory, retrieval reasoning, and evolving personality inference with a 2,000-case long-term benchmark.

works.title: PERSPECTRA: A Scalable and Configurable Pluralist Benchmark of Perspectives from Arguments
works.description: Constructs 3,810 structured yet naturalistic arguments and three tasks for distinguishing rather than collapsing plural viewpoints.

works.title: PLURAL: A Global Dataset for Value Alignment
works.description: Transforms nationally representative value surveys into roughly 500,000 preference triplets and validates retained diversity, learnability, and target-country fit with human raters.

works.title: PluriHarms: Benchmarking the Full Spectrum of Human Judgments on AI Harm
works.description: Jointly measures harm severity and disagreement using 15,000 ratings enriched with demographic, psychological, action, effect, and value features.

works.title: Polar: A Benchmark for Evaluating Political Bias in LLMs
works.description: Measures likelihood-based political positioning across two ideological axes, eight issues, two national contexts, two languages, and 38 models.

works.title: Political Alignment in Large Language Models: A Multidimensional Audit of Psychometric Identity and Behavioral Bias
works.description: Separates prompt and model effects across three political inventories and finds psychometric positioning does not predict downstream news-bias errors.

works.title: Political Neutrality as Balanced Approval: A Large-Scale Human Evaluation of AI Responses
works.description: Offers an operational neutrality criterion and PARETO dataset with 208,152 evaluations from 7,434 participants across opposing political groups.

works.title: Position: Align AI to Our Aspirations, Not Our Flaws
works.description: Challenges preference aggregation as the alignment target and proposes a non-negotiable competence, truth, honesty, and lawfulness floor with bounded pluralism.

works.title: Position: The Alignment Community is Unintentionally Building a Censor's Toolkit
works.description: Systematizes the dual-use censorship potential of filtering, post-training preference alignment, and inference-time control.

works.title: Preference Heads in Large Language Models: A Mechanistic Framework for Interpretable Personalization
works.description: Uses causal masking to identify sparse attention heads and training-free differential decoding to strengthen user-specific topical and stylistic preferences.

works.title: Preference-Aware Rubric Learning for Personalized Evaluation
works.description: Learns and self-validates user-specific rubrics from histories, then optimizes their discriminative power against competitive outputs.

works.title: Probing Ethical Framework Representations in Large Language Models: Structure, Entanglement, and Methodological Challenges
works.description: Maps asymmetric hidden-space relations among five ethical frameworks across six LLMs while explicitly testing template-feature dependence.

works.title: Prompt Perturbations Reveal Human-Like Biases in Large Language Model Survey Responses
works.description: Runs over 167,000 WVS interviews with ten perturbations and documents universal recency bias plus semantic prompt sensitivity.

works.title: Prompt Robustness Is Task-Dependent: Comparing Objective and Belief-Style Questions in LLM Evaluation
works.description: Directly contrasts robustness of objective tasks with Political Compass, ValueBench, and WVS under wording, framing, and format changes.

works.title: Pseudo-Deliberation in Language Models: When Reasoning Fails to Align Values and Actions
works.description: Defines pseudo-deliberation and introduces VALDI with 4,941 scenarios, three elicitation stages, and five value-adherence metrics plus an intervention framework.

works.title: Relative Principals, Pluralistic Alignment, and the Structural Value Alignment Problem
works.description: Reframes alignment through interacting objective, information, and principal axes to expose stakeholder-relative governance trade-offs.

works.title: Role Steering of Language Models for Social Simulations
works.description: Provides a role-level activation-steering screen and shows why coefficient selection must vary across a 275-role social-simulation inventory.

works.title: Should LLM Agents Decide in Social Simulations? Comparing Finite-State and LLM-Based Decision Policies
works.description: Shows across 10,000 decisions that LLM selectors inconsistently preserve explicit Markov policies and are hundreds of times slower.

works.title: Silicon Sampling via Cross-Survey Transfer
works.description: Introduces individual-level cross-survey prediction to distinguish coherent respondent simulation from aggregate pattern matching.

works.title: Simple Role Assignment is Extraordinarily Effective for Safety Alignment
works.description: Uses socially encoded roles as contextual alignment priors and reports large safety gains across five model families.

works.title: Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models
works.description: Introduces balanced reward-model training for seven national subcommunities and evaluates minority performance and cultural bias separately.

works.title: Steering LLMs for Culturally Localized Generation
works.description: Extracts sparse-autoencoder cultural embeddings that diagnose latent bias and enable controllable white-box localization beyond prompting.

works.title: Stop Drawing Scientific Claims from LLM Social Simulations Without Robustness Audits
works.description: Demonstrates extreme macro-outcome sensitivity to minor simulation choices and contributes the three-level TRAILS robustness taxonomy.

works.title: Superficial Beliefs in LLM Decision-Making
works.description: Shows behaviorally inferred attribute priorities predict choices while self-reports and judge scores only partly recover those drivers.

works.title: Swap-guided Preference Learning for Personalized Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
works.description: Identifies posterior collapse in variational preference learning and uses fictitious swap annotators to recover informative user-specific latents.

works.title: Test-Time Personalization: A Diagnostic Framework and Probabilistic Fix for Scaling Failures
works.description: Derives a measurable Best-of-N personalization scaling law and addresses user collapse and query-level reward hacking probabilistically.

works.title: The GaoYao Benchmark: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Multilingual and Multicultural Abilities of Large Language Models
works.description: Unifies three cultural layers and nine cognitive sublayers in a 182,300-sample, 26-language, 51-region benchmark with expert localization.

works.title: The Personalization Mirage: How LLMs Fabricate User Profiles, and Why Self-Monitoring Misleads
works.description: Introduces MirageBench and human-validated claim labels, finding pervasive user-profile over-inference and misleading cross-model self-monitoring.

works.title: The Pluralistic Moral Gap: Understanding Moral Judgment and Value Differences between Humans and Large Language Models
works.description: Combines 1,618 real dilemmas, human judgment distributions, a 60-value rationale taxonomy, and a Dirichlet intervention to measure and reduce pluralistic moral gaps.

works.title: Think-While-Generating: On-the-Fly Reasoning for Personalized Long-Form Generation
works.description: Introduces parallel latent reasoning that updates token-level guidance during personalized long-form generation without sequential reasoning bottlenecks.

works.title: Toward Culturally Aligned LLMs through Ontology-Guided Multi-Agent Reasoning
works.description: Builds a WVS-derived cultural-value ontology and retrieves both value relations and demographically proximate profiles for multi-agent synthesis.

works.title: Toward Culturally Grounded Natural Language Processing
works.description: Synthesizes over 50 papers and proposes a communicative-ecology agenda spanning provenance, mixed elicitation, validation, and resource maintenance.

works.title: Towards Cross-lingual Values Judgment: A Consensus-Pluralism Perspective
works.description: Introduces X-Value with 4,750 pairs in 14 languages and rich metadata through a staged human-AI values-judgment protocol.

works.title: Tracing Moral Foundations in Large Language Models
works.description: Triangulates layer geometry, sparse features, post-training changes, and causal steering for five moral foundations across 14 models.

works.title: TriAlign: Towards Universal Truth Consistency in Personalized LLM Alignment
works.description: Defines truth-invariant personalization and jointly optimizes objective accuracy, cross-group consistency, and subjective adaptation using offline MARL.

works.title: Understanding Cultural Alignment in Multilingual LLMs via Natural Debate Statements
works.description: Creates human-checked debate statements mapped to Hofstede dimensions and compares culturally distinct LLM groups against human patterns.

works.title: Understanding Moral Reasoning Trajectories in Large Language Models: Toward Probing-Based Explainability
works.description: Defines framework-switch trajectories, localizes ethical encodings, links instability to attacks, and validates a representation-consistency metric.

works.title: Untangling Input Language from Reasoning Language: A Diagnostic Framework for Cross-Lingual Moral Alignment in LLMs
works.description: Factorially separates dilemma language from reasoning language across 13 models and interprets shifts through Moral Foundations Theory.

works.title: Value-Based Human–Robot-Interaction: A Perceptual Control Theory Approach Toward Socially Intelligent Agents
works.description: Proposes a perceptual-control framework for robots to dynamically arbitrate human values at interaction time rather than only at design time.

works.title: ValueFlow: Measuring the Propagation of Value Perturbations in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
works.description: Introduces agent susceptibility and system susceptibility to trace Schwartz-derived value perturbations across models, personas, and network topologies.

works.title: VALUEFLOW: Toward Pluralistic and Steerable Value-based Alignment in Large Language Models
works.description: Unifies a hierarchical cross-theory value space, intensity-labeled text database, rank-anchored evaluator, and calibrated steering across four theories.

works.title: VC-Soup: Value-Consistency Guided Multi-Value Alignment for Large Language Models
works.description: Filters preference pairs by cross-value reward consistency and merges value-specific policies to improve Pareto trade-offs without retraining each combination.

works.title: VISA: Value Injection via Shielded Adaptation for Personalized LLM Alignment
works.description: Combines fine-grained value detection, value translation, and GRPO rewriting to control value expression while shielding semantics and factuality.

works.title: VISPA: Pluralistic Alignment via Automatic Value Selection and Activation
works.description: Provides training-free dynamic value selection and activation steering for multiple pluralistic-alignment modes.

works.title: What's In My Human Feedback? Learning Interpretable Descriptions of Preference Data
works.description: Uses sparse features to separate measurable from expressed preferences across seven datasets and demonstrates actionable safety curation and personalization.

works.title: When Synthetic Users Fail: A Cross-Domain Benchmark of LLM-Simulated Human Survey Responses
works.description: Cross-validates synthetic respondents on GSS and WVS, finding baseline underperformance, demographic over-determination, and consequential targeting errors.

works.title: Which Values Do LLMs Confuse? A Schwartz-Based Recognition Study
works.description: Establishes value recognition as a prerequisite and maps stable directed confusions across 1,000 human-labeled Schwartz situations and 20 reliable runs.

works.title: Whose Alignment? Comparing LLM Process Alignment Across Diverse Organizational Decision Contexts
works.description: Measures whether models reproduce organizational decision policies and shows process alignment can diverge from accuracy and normative desirability.

works.title: Why Are We Moral? An LLM-based Agent Simulation Approach to Study Moral Evolution
works.description: Uses cognitively expressive LLM agents to test moral observability and communication effects in a simulated evolutionary society.

works.title: XCR-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Cultural Reasoning in LLMs via Culture-Specific Items and Hall's Triad
works.description: Builds 4,100 parallel sentences and 1,098 culture-specific items spanning observable practices through implicit norms and values.

works.title: XL-SafetyBench: A Country-Grounded Cross-Cultural Benchmark for LLM Safety and Cultural Sensitivity
works.description: Separates jailbreak robustness, neutral safety, and cultural sensitivity across 5,500 locally annotated cases and 37 models.
